Horizon3 is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organizations to proactively find and fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. title: Senior Manager, Sales Technology & AI Enablement
description:

Axiom, a leading global marketplace for on-demand legal talent, is leading a revolution in the legal industry. The Axiom model disrupts the traditional allocation of work to law firms and in-house teams. By matching highly credentialed lawyers and legal talent with legal work across industries and practice areas, Axiom enables clients to become more agile and efficient and empowers lawyers and legal talent to pursue more of the work they love. The role does not own enterprise system administration or design Axiom's client AI solutions. title: Sales Specialist (Italy)
description:
About Ping Identity:

At Ping Identity, we believe in making digital experiences both secure and seamless for all users, without compromise. We call this digital freedom. And it's not just something we provide our customers. It's something that inspires our company. People don't come here to join a culture that's built on digital freedom. They come to cultivate it.

Our intelligent, cloud identity platform lets people shop, work, bank, and interact wherever and however they want. Without friction. Without fear.

While protecting digital identities is at the core of our technology, protecting individual identities is at the core of our culture. We champion every identity. One of our core values, Respect Individuality, reminds us to celebrate differences so you are empowered to bring your authentic self to work.

We're headquartered in Denver, Colorado and we have offices and employees around the globe. We serve the largest, most demanding enterprises worldwide, including more than half of the Fortune 100. At Ping Identity, we're changing the way people and businesses think about cybersecurity, digital experiences, and identity and access management.

Reporting to the Sales Director, the Sales Specialist is a field-based position dedicated to driving the adoption of our cutting-edge PingOne Recognize biometric authentication technology. Unlike a traditional generalist role, you will act as a subject matter expert, focusing on net-new logo acquisition and strategic upsells by positioning PingOne Recognize products as the gold standard for passwordless, zero-trust environments. You will leverage a robust internal resource model and global partner directory to displace legacy MFA and revolutionize how enterprises handle digital trust.

You will:

  • Lead the Passwordless Revolution: Create and execute a territory strategy specifically designed to evangelize PingOne Recognize, targeting organizations burdened by legacy MFA and high-friction authentication.
  • Master the Value Prop: Articulate the unique technical and business value of PingOne Recognize—privacy-preserving biometrics, zero-knowledge architecture, and the elimination of credential-based attacks.
  • Engineer Complex Deals: Navigate and close high-stakes contracts by demonstrating how PingOne Recognize integrates into existing CIAM and IAM ecosystems to reduce fraud and improve user experience.
  • Act as a Market Liaison: Provide direct field intelligence to Product and Engineering teams to ensure the PingOne Recognize roadmap remains the industry leader in biometric innovation.
  • Orchestrate Specialist Resources: Work collaboratively with Sales Engineers and Privacy experts to address deep technical inquiries regarding biometric data and compliance.

title: Senior Manager, Sales UKI
description:
About Pleo

At Pleo, we believe that finance is the strategic force at the heart of how every business runs. When a finance team leads with its craft, they make better decisions and steer the business with more confidence. In order to do that, the busywork that comes with expense management needs to move out the way.

That’s why we built a spend management platform that streamlines the whole process, from employee spending to approvals and reconciliation. Finance teams get clarity and control of all the numbers and data in one place and employees get an experience that they actually enjoy.

The word “Pleo” in Greek means “more than you’d expect,” and that mindset has driven our growth since 2015 and our 40,000+ customers. Today we’re 750+ people from over 65 nationalities who take pride in understanding customer needs, turning complex problems into simple solutions, challenging the way things are done, and aiming for the highest outcome. We haven’t got everything figured out, but we’re committed to developing and delivering an experience as elevated as the craft of finance.

About the role

We’re looking for a Senior Sales Manager to join our commercial team at Pleo. In this role, you'll help drive hyper-growth across the UK/I market, lead and scale our high-performing Mid-Market sales organisation, and be part of our commercial leadership team as we scale our smart company spending platform. If you're excited about leading an entrepreneurial sales engine, empowering reps through coaching and frameworks like MEDDIC, and are passionate about the future of corporate spend management and Fintech, then this is the opportunity for you!

title: Senior Security Operations Analyst
description:
About Zable

Zable (formerly Lendable) is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money.

  • Founded in 2014, profitable since 2017, unicorn since 2021

  • The number one issuer of new credit cards and loans in the UK

  • Backed by Balderton Capital and Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan

  • Loved by customers & our team with top reviews on Glassdoor and Trustpilot

Zable was founded on the belief that smarter technology is the solution to lower cost, more transparent consumer finance. Our proprietary foundation models analyse thousands of data points in seconds, drawing a more complete picture of individual financial behaviour. This means we can make better risk decisions, widening access and lowering prices.

The Zable credit card harnesses this technology to deliver better borrowing for three million people. Through our superapp, Zable connects this card to a single platform which makes it effortless to manage credit, get a loan, refinance existing borrowing, switch utilities, get a mobile plan and save more.

Zable is now the number one issuer of new credit cards and personal loans in the UK, but we’ve barely got started. Next, we’re taking our approach to some of the biggest markets in the world - the US and Mexico - where hundreds of millions of people are underserved by outdated bank processes.

title: Staff AI Engineer - Architecture skills
General Accountant - Accounts Payable
Acquisition Operations
description:
Who We Are

Zefir is building an AI autopilot for home sales in Europe, starting in France. Our agent runs each sale from listing to closing. It coordinates buyers, sellers, and local brokers, manages listings across property portals, and handles the paperwork. We help homeowners sell for the best price on a timeline that works for them.

We’ve raised €60 million from Sequoia Capital and other leading investors. Our goal is to help millions of Europeans take the next step in their lives, whether that means moving to a new city for work or making room for a growing family.

The mission

Zefir sells homes with an AI agent, but our growth is still run mostly by hand.

Every week, someone reads the dashboards, works out why bookings dropped on Tuesday, moves budget from one channel to another, asks for new creatives and fixes a broken tracking tag. Each of these tasks follows rules we could write down. Your job is to write them down and hand them to agents: software that watches the funnel all day, explains what changed and makes the routine fixes itself, within limits the team sets.

You'll learn those rules by doing the work first. From day one you run our acquisition: around €1M of spend a month on Meta, Google and new channels, in a business growing about 2.5x a year. The number you answer for is the expected margin of each call we book. Cheap leads that never become sellers don't count. Anything you still do by hand after six months is a task you haven't automated yet.

Few places let you try this. Most companies spending this much are too slow to hand decisions to agents, and most companies that would let you are too small to give the agents anything to decide. Here you get both, and nobody has written the playbook yet.

At Gorgias, we’re building the platform that makes this real: a unified AI agent that sells, supports, and re-engages customers across the entire journey. Conversational Commerce is the future of ecommerce, and we’re leading that shift.

Our mission is to turn every interaction between a brand and its customers into a relationship: personal, seamless, and intelligent. By combining deep product expertise with the latest in AI, we’re making shopping feel more natural, human, and connected than ever before.

To win, we focus relentlessly on:

  • Quality: conversations that feel authentic and on-brand.

  • Experience: effortless shopping from chat to checkout.

  • Re-engagement: personal, 1-1 dialogue instead of noisy marketing.

The opportunity is massive. As AI reshapes how people buy, Gorgias is building the foundation for the next decade of ecommerce, where every brand has its own intelligent agent and every customer feels understood.

Join us to make Conversational Commerce real.

The AI Deployment (Customer Implementation) Team at Gorgias is dedicated to ensuring a seamless and successful start for every customer's journey with our products. title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
sizeless builds the data layer for physical AI in construction. Contractors film an open trench with a smartphone. Our system turns that video into a 3D model, recognises what is in the ground, and delivers the documentation the industry needs – CAD, BIM, GIS and quantities. The same data is the foundation for training the robots that will one day work on construction sites.

It is a real problem with real customers: construction and utilities still document reality by hand, and almost nothing about that process has changed in decades. We are a small team with research experience from ETH Zurich, UC Berkeley and MIT, and we are looking for an engineer who wants to bring this technology onto real construction sites and make it work for our customers.

Tasks

  • Work directly with our customers – contractors, utilities and surveyors in Switzerland, Germany and Austria – from first site visit to daily use

  • Get field crews up and running with our capture app, on site and remotely

  • Adapt our outputs to each customer's CAD, GIS and documentation standards

  • Write the scripts, integrations and tooling that connect sizeless to customer systems

  • Bring what you learn on site back into the product, together with the engineering team

Requirements

  • Solid engineering fundamentals in TypeScript, Python or a comparable language

  • You enjoy working with customers and are comfortable on a construction site

  • Ownership: you take problems personally and see them through

  • Fluent German and English – most of our customers work in German

  • Willingness to travel regularly within Switzerland, Germany and Austria and valid driving licence (category B)

Experience with 3D data, mobile apps or geospatial systems is welcome. We care more that you learn quickly and take details seriously.

Reporting to our CTO, you look two to five years ahead and beyond, and shape our product line across several generations, so that what we build today still makes sense for our customers tomorrow. You work with our customers' technology roadmaps, marketing, the heads of R&D, our function architects and customer support, and you lead through persuasion rather than formal authority. Our system engineer builds on your concept and makes the current program work to spec. The role includes occasional travel to customers in Asia, the US and Europe.

  • Make and justify the key concept choices, weighing physics, performance, cost and risk

  • Decompose the system into modules and interfaces, and allocate the key budgets, such as throughput, cost of goods, availability and performance

About Focused Energy

Focused Energy is building laser-driven inertial fusion as a commercial source of clean power. Our $240M Series A is the largest fully secured Series A in the global fusion industry, and we are using it to grow teams in Germany and the US at the same time.

Your Role

As the Senior HR Business Partner, you will be the People partner for our Engineering department, one of the fastest growing parts of the company. It brings together mechanical, electrical, hardware and other engineering disciplines, led by people who are hiring faster than their structures can keep up. Many of them are leading at this scale for the first time. They do not need HR explained to them. They need someone who understands what their team is trying to deliver and helps them decide how to organize, grow and lead it.

This year we ran our first formal performance review and introduced a career framework. Both are in place and neither is finished. You will take what exists and make it hold as the company grows: calibration that leaders trust, levels that mean the same thing in Darmstadt and in Austin, promotion decisions that can be explained to the person who did not get one. You will have room to do that work.

People Operations runs contracts, payroll and HR administration. Talent Acquisition runs hiring. You join a team of Business Partners, and your time goes into partnering and building.

A background in fusion is not required. We expect you to want to learn how the business works, because your advice is only as good as your understanding of it.

*This position is based in Darmstadt and requires onsite presence three days a week. This role reports to the Director People. German and English fluency are required.

title: Strategy & Operations Lead (f/m/d)
description:
Short Description

SPREAD builds engineering intelligence for the world's most complex products. Our AI-native platform gives automotive OEMs, defense primes, and industrial manufacturers a single source of product truth so engineering teams can make confident product decisions, fast. We work with companies like Volkswagen, BMW, Mercedes-Benz, Audi, Bosch, and Rheinmetall. Backed by HV Capital, DTCP, La Famiglia, and Salesforce, and recognized with the SPARK AI Innovation Award and a place among LinkedIn's Top Startups in DACH.

Role
In this role, you sit inside the Founders' Office and work on the decisions that set SPREAD's direction. You own the strategy cycle and translate it into company goals and OKRs; you drive the strategic and improvement initiatives that come out of it, and you run the operating rhythm that keeps the leadership team deciding and the company executing. Alongside that, you own SPREAD's ecosystem of partners and senior industry advisors. You shape how the whole company hears about strategy through the monthly Assembly, and you build the material founders and the leadership team decide on. You report to the VP Strategy & Finance and work daily with the founders, the leadership team, and the people delivering the outcomes you help define.

Your Mission

title: Creative Lead (gn)
description:
Jobbeschreibung

Intermate x SAMY – Shaping the State of Social

Intermate gehört zu den größten Social-Media- und Influencer-Agenturen im DACH-Raum. Mit mehr als 250 Mates in Berlin, Hamburg, Köln und Remote entwickeln wir Social-First-Strategien, produzieren Content in eigenen Studios, arbeiten eng mit Creator:innen zusammen und steuern Kampagnen datengetrieben über unsere eigene Technologie. Unsere Kund:innen sind einige der bekanntesten Marken der Welt – von Lifestyle über FMCG bis hin zu Tech.

Als Teil von SAMY, einem globalen Agenturnetzwerk für Social Media und Creator Marketing, sind wir mit über 970 Expert:innen an 20 Standorten vernetzt. Das eröffnet internationale Perspektiven, Projekte in rund 55 Märkten und die Möglichkeit, dich weit über Ländergrenzen hinweg weiterzuentwickeln.

💡 👉 Hinweis: Unser Bewerbungsprozess wird teilweise von einem KI-gestützten Assistenten begleitet, der das erste Kennenlerngespräch führt. Weitere Informationen erhältst du im Verlauf deiner Bewerbung.

DEINE ROLLE

Wir bauen für einen unserer Hero Accounts eine Creative Unit auf – und du übernimmst dafür die fachliche und disziplinarische Führung. Als Creative Lead bist du Hauptansprechpartner:in für diesen Kunden und trägst die kreative Verantwortung: von der strategischen Ausrichtung über die konzeptionelle Qualität bis zur Führung deines Teams.
Es geht um Big Ideas, Kampagnen und Talkability. Nicht nur um das nächste Posting. Auch wenn du aus einem eher klassischen kreative Umfeld kommst, bist du bei uns richtig. Social-First-Erfahrung ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss. Wichtiger ist, dass du weißt, wie große Ideen entstehen und wie man ein Team dahin führt.

Als Creative Lead setzt du neue kreative Standards, holst neue Skillsets und Perspektiven ins Team und sorgst dafür, dass eure Arbeit den Unterschied macht – bei Kund:innen genauso wie bei renommierten Kreativ Wettbewerben.

title: Senior Accountant
description:
About Zable

Zable (formerly Lendable) is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money.

  • Founded in 2014, profitable since 2017, unicorn since 2021

  • The number one issuer of new credit cards and loans in the UK

  • Backed by Balderton Capital and Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan

  • Loved by customers & our team with top reviews on Glassdoor and Trustpilot

Zable was founded on the belief that smarter technology is the solution to lower cost, more transparent consumer finance. Our proprietary foundation models analyse thousands of data points in seconds, drawing a more complete picture of individual financial behaviour. This means we can make better risk decisions, widening access and lowering prices.

The Zable credit card harnesses this technology to deliver better borrowing for three million people. Through our superapp, Zable connects this card to a single platform which makes it effortless to manage credit, get a loan, refinance existing borrowing, switch utilities, get a mobile plan and save more.

Zable is now the number one issuer of new credit cards and personal loans in the UK, but we’ve barely got started. Next, we’re taking our approach to some of the biggest markets in the world - the US and Mexico - where hundreds of millions of people are underserved by outdated bank processes.

description:
Notre mission ⚖️

Chez Doctrine, nous construisons le leader de l’IA juridique en Europe.

Notre conviction ? Le droit ne doit pas être ralenti par des tâches répétitives. Il doit être augmenté par une IA spécialisée, conçue pour comprendre, analyser et produire du raisonnement juridique avec un haut niveau d’exigence.

Notre ambition ? Permettre aux professionnels du droit de gagner en fiabilité, en efficacité et en sérénité, grâce à une plateforme unique, exhaustive et sécurisée.

Aujourd’hui, 27 000 professionnels du droit, répartis dans cinq pays (France, Italie, Allemagne, Espagne, Luxembourg), nous font confiance.

Notre développement est guidé par une approche claire : une vision globale, ancrée dans une compréhension fine des spécificités locales.

Derrière cette ambition, une équipe d’environ 250 personnes, réunies autour d’un même objectif : accompagner les juristes et avocats à toutes les étapes de leur travail, de l’analyse à la rédaction.

Et nous n’en sommes qu’au début.


Sujet de stage

Doctrine développe des workflows dédiés aux professionnels du droit pour accélérer et améliorer la gestion de leurs dossiers. Parmi eux, Jobexit accompagne les avocats et juristes en droit social dans la simulation de ruptures du contrat de travail, notamment en calculant les indemnités de départ, les indemnités en cas de contentieux, le calendrier de sortie et les allocations chômage.

Dans un litige, un salarié peut demander plusieurs choses à la fois : des salaires impayés, une indemnité de licenciement, des dommages et intérêts, etc. L'objectif du stage est de permettre à l'utilisateur de saisir et d'organiser toutes ces demandes dans l'application, pour mieux estimer les montants en jeu, préparer la négociation avec la partie adverse et générer automatiquement le récapitulatif final destiné au juge. title: Software Engineer - Dynamics
description:
Wanna join the adventure?

Loft Orbital is looking for a Software Engineer to join the Dynamics team within Ground Platform. Dynamics computes the timeline of what every spacecraft in our fleet can do and when (contacts with ground stations, links, accesses, unavailability windows) and turns it into schedules: which satellite talks to which ground station, when, and in which order of priority.

As our fleet grows, these services need to handle more data, more queries, and harder allocation problems. You’ll bring strong backend engineering to that challenge: making our APIs fast, our databases scale, and our contact allocation and scheduling smarter. No astrodynamics background is needed; you’ll work alongside flight dynamics engineers who bring that expertise.

If you enjoy hard performance problems and optimization with real-world constraints, we’d love to hear from you.


About this role:
  • Build and optimize our scheduling capabilities: model constraints and objectives, design algorithms and solver-based approaches that produce feasible, high-quality schedules across a growing fleet, and replan quickly when things change
  • Evolve contact allocation (Contact Allocation Framework) to share ground station capacity across satellites and missions
  • Improve the performance of our backend services and APIs: profile, find bottlenecks and cut latency for the timeline and scheduling services that operators and other teams rely on
  • Design and evolve our data layer for large, fast-growing time-based datasets: data modeling, partitioning, indexing, query optimization and retention

We translate complex workflows and mission data into clear, dependable experiences that help customers and partners collaborate with Loft teams and move their missions forward, establishing a standard for space mission execution at scale.

We’re hiring for one position across multiple locations - you only need to apply once.


About this role:
  • Build and operate backend services and end-to-end features to collect, manage, and surface critical infrastructure data, and help external parties implement their missions on the Loft infrastructure
  • Design and implement APIs and integrations that connect tools and data across teams and systems, with a focus on backend architecture, performance, and reliability
  • Contribute to the development and maintenance of performant, accessible user interfaces to support internal teams and external users
  • Work with program management, satellite engineering, operations, and business stakeholders to understand mission design and implementation, program, and business processes, and translate them into intuitive, reliable software
  • Apply a product mindset across the stack: seek user feedback, identify friction in backend workflows and user experiences, and deliver solutions that reduce complexity for the teams building and operating space infrastructure

    • Must Haves:
  • Strong proficiency in Python for backend engineering
  • Practical experience with Docker for containerization and deployment
  • Experience with backend architecture, API design, and database interactions

Our platform revolutionizes the way our customers generate sensor data for AI development. We're looking for people like you to join us in pushing the boundaries of artificial intelligence and synthetic data.

About the role 

Before any physical AI system is trusted in the real world, it has to prove itself in ours. Parallel Domain turns real captured drives into faithful digital replicas — geometry, appearance and motion that perception stacks are trained and validated against.
 
We are hiring a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to push our feed-forward reconstruction stack forward — from static 3D toward full 4D scenes over time. You will join a small, deep team where your technical judgment carries real weight from day one, and your work will ship in a pipeline customers depend on.

What You'll Do
  • Advance our feed-forward reconstruction models. Improve how we predict geometry, camera pose and appearance from real capture with transformer-based models, and extend it from static scenes to dynamic 4D.
  • Train at scale. Run multi-node GPU training on large multi-view and video datasets, and decide what to scale, what to ablate and when a result is real.
  • Define what "good" means. Build evaluation the team trusts for reconstruction quality, temporal consistency and geometric accuracy.
  • Explore stronger priors. Investigate where generative models, such as pre-trained video diffusion, can help fill gaps the capture did not see.

title: Meridial – Senior Research Software Engineer – Image Processing
description:
About Meridial

Meridial is a Focused Research Organisation (FRO) with a mission to bring connectomics into the living brain. We are building a platform for longitudinal, synapse-resolution mapping of functional neural circuitry in preclinical models. Our aim is to deploy this platform for translational projects and improve drug development outcomes for disorders of the central nervous system.

Meridial is a new not-for-profit FRO in the Convergent Research Ecosystem and funded by the Advanced Research and Invention Agency (ARIA).

The technical challenge

Our imaging platform records the activity of neurons and synapses in the living brain. The scientific value of these recordings depends on converting raw images into reliable, quantitative data.

This is a demanding image processing problem. Fluorescence signals are faint, noisy and spatially overlapping; residual tissue motion and other imaging artefacts must be corrected; in addition to conventional planar frames, data may be acquired from arbitrarily shaped 3D regions or several depths at once; properties vary between signal types and experimental configurations; and the same cells and synapses must be reliably matched across imaging sessions spanning weeks. You will build a software package that addresses these challenges in two modes: real-time processing and visualisation, with latencies of tens to hundreds of milliseconds, that inform experimental decisions at the microscope, and offline pipelines that deliver maximum accuracy for scientific analysis and serve as the benchmark for the real-time methods.

The impact of this work is direct and visible: your software will be used at the microscope as experiments unfold, and your pipelines will generate the data underpinning new insights into how neural circuits function and how they change in disease.

Our data scientists optimize how each battery operates at its site. You focus on trading our fleet's flexibility in power markets. Both areas are closely linked, and our quantitative researchers and data scientists work as one team, often across each other's topics. We believe our edge will come from better use of data, new approaches and sharper predictions.

 

What you will do

  • Developing our trading strategies on Day-Ahead and Intraday, from research and backtesting to live operation.

  • Building and improving price forecasts for short-term markets and turning them into trading signals.

  • Bidding and trading the fleet's available flexibility under uncertainty and real operational constraints.

  • Managing risk: imbalance costs, execution quality and the trade-off between expected value and downside.

  • Measuring captured value against clear benchmarks and finding where we can do better.

  • Shaping how we access markets and expand to further markets and products as we grow.

  • Bringing models into production together with our engineers.

 

What we are looking for

title: Grid Manager
description:
Role

We are hiring a Grid Manager to get our batteries onto the grid. Every BEO project has a grid connection point, and you are taking care of this vital element.

Together with our Sales and Operations teams, you own everything between our projects and the power grid: you secure connection capacity, translate grid codes and regulation into solutions that work, and become the go-to counterpart for grid operators.

 

What you will do

Every battery we install needs a grid connection. You make sure it gets one, quickly and on good terms.

  • Grid connections: You own the grid connection process for our projects, from connection requests and capacity reservation to signed agreements with distribution system operators.

  • Technical concepts: You analyse connection conditions, technical connection rules (VDE-AR-N 4105/4110), and the regulatory framework and turn them into concepts. Together with our team you shape the design of the connection point: protection, metering, and certification.

  • Grid operator relationships: You build strong working relationships with grid operators and are the internal go-to for every grid question, from Sales to Operations.

  • Scalable processes: You build the processes and templates that let us connect faster with every project, keep track of regulatory changes, and represent BEO in industry associations.

 

What we're looking for

  • Up to 3 years of experience in grid connection, grid operat

title: Founding Talent Lead
description:
Role

We are hiring someone to build up and own our talent function end-to-end. Recruiting, developing and retaining the best people is absolutely fundamental to our success. It’s also one of the most fun parts of building.

Together with our founders, you will build and own the entire talent stack: we’ll start with sourcing and winning the best talent (including building a long-term talent pool that we can rely on as we scale), and then move into building performance reviews and people development.

We have come this far because we have the best people, and we will go further because we keep finding them. Your job is to make sure that the biggest constraint on our growth is never people.

 

What you will do

We are scaling incredibly fast across all functions. We are 25 people today and will be a multiple of that next year.

  • Winning talent: you find the best people for engineering, sales, and ops roles, build the channels that keep candidates coming, and help the team turn the right ones into hires. You’ll help us do whatever it takes to recruit the best talent (even if that is a creative signing present). You make sure our recruiting process is ultra fast and convincing. You define the steps, keep candidates moving fast, prepare the team for interviews, and make sure we do not lose people we wanted. When someone turns us down, you build the strategy to change their minds. Beyond immediate hiring needs, you’ll build a long-term talent network (feel free to host amazing events).

  • People development: we don’t really have a structured process for this today. We may never. You’ll work with us on defining the right approach for performance

title: Technical Product Manager – Local Control System
description:
Role

You’ll build our in-house local control system from scratch: the on-site controller hardware and the software that decides how each battery charges and discharges. You own the product across hardware and software, from the first design to a reliable system running across our fleet.

 

What you will do

You will work with a dedicated developer team, and closely with our data scientists and Operations team. Your responsibilities will be:

  • Define the local control software, including dispatch logic, control strategies, fallbacks and interfaces to batteries, meters and the central platform.

  • Enable our Operations team to bring new sites live through tooling, documentation and hands-on support.

  • Own the product backlog, prioritize requirements across Operations, grid operations and the central platform, and work with developers from specification through release.

  • Design a configuration schema that works across all sites without requiring site-specific logic.

  • Own field reliability, including edge device requirements, testing, safety, release management and fleet-wide updates.

  • Drive the integration of power plant controllers and protection devices, and own IT security and the software requirements for grid services prequalification.

 

What we are looking for

  • Experience with software that controls physical systems and being in a product role, ideally in energy (battery storage, PV, inverters, SCADA or similar). Having taken a p

title: SCADA Engineer
description:
Role

We are hiring a SCADA Engineer to own everything that connects our batteries. A BEO site only creates value once it talks to our optimization engine, the grid operator, and the market, and you are the one who makes it talk.

You are our internal owner for all SCADA topics and responsible for the data and communication commissioning of our storage systems: from the field level to the cloud, from the first concept until the site is live and monitored. We are growing to the next order of magnitude, and the standards you set decide how fast every new site goes live.

 

What you will do

We are connecting more batteries every month. You make sure each one is online, reliable, and secure from day one.

  • Architecture and standards: You define the SCADA and system architecture of our sites, from inverters and meters up to the cloud. You set the requirements together with our Product Team, select the components, and turn what works into a standard for every project.

  • Commissioning: You plan and run the data and communication commissioning of our batteries, including all interfaces for monitoring, maintenance, trading, and the grid operator. When needed, you are on site (occasional travel within Germany), and you stay on it until the site runs stable.

  • Control and security: You help shape the control concept of our sites and make sure everything we connect meets regulatory and cyber security requirements. Along the way, you coordinate suppliers, integrators, and grid operators.

 

What we're looking for

title: Software Engineer
description:
Role

You’ll build the backend that powers our battery fleet: the services and APIs at the heart of our platform and the control plane of our own fleet management system across all sites. You will work in an interdisciplinary team where software engineers, data scientists and quants build together.

 

What you will do

The role covers two linked areas. You will own at least one of them, and we welcome people who want to work across both:

  • Core: Design and build the Python services and APIs at the center of our platform, used by our optimization engine, internal tools and customer products. You own their architecture, scalability, security and code quality. You also contribute to the customer-facing web applications built on these services.

  • Fleet Management System: Build the backend that manages our fleet: site and device configuration, getting schedules and commands to each site, and tracking what every site is actually doing. You make sure the right instructions reach the right battery reliably and securely, even when connections or devices fail.

You will own the backend that our optimization runs on. Your tasks include:

  • Design and build backend services and APIs in Python that connect batteries, our optimization engine and our products.

  • Own service architecture and make it scale as we grow from pilot sites to thousands of connected battery systems.

  • Build security: authentication and authorization, secure APIs, secrets management and safe access to devices on site.

title: Senior Consultant Digital Measurement & Privacy Tech (m/w/d)
description:
Senior Consultant Digital Measurement & Privacy Tech (m/w/d)

Du bringst Tracking-Praxis mit, lernst bei uns Privacy Tech und betreust eigene Enterprise-Kunden wie Commerzbank, FedEx oder On.

Ohne Einwilligung keine Daten, ohne saubere Daten kein Marketing. Die Regeln dafür werden in Europa wie in den USA jedes Jahr strenger — und die meisten Unternehmen merken erst spät, dass ein Cookie-Banner keine Strategie ist. Genau an dieser Stelle arbeiten wir: Seit 2018 setzen wir Datenschutz technisch um, seit 2020 auch US-Privacy-Regulierung, in über 400 Projekten für mehr als 80 Kunden in 15 Ländern.

Du kannst Tracking? Dann lernst du bei uns, was in Deutschland kaum jemand kann. Spezialisten für Privacy Tech gibt es am Markt praktisch nicht — deshalb suchen wir niemanden, der es schon kann, sondern jemanden mit echter Measurement-Erfahrung, dem wir Consent und Privacy selbst beibringen. Ab Tag 1 betreust du eigene Kunden, baust Setups mit GA4, Google Tag Manager und Server-Side selbst und sprichst mit Anwält:innen genauso wie mit Entwickler:innen.

Wir sind neun Leute, wachsen seit Jahren organisch und bauen gerade unser Team in Hamburg auf. Wer hier überzeugt, übernimmt in ein bis zwei Jahren Verantwortung für das Consulting-Team.

Warum es diese Rolle gibt

Wir wachsen in beiden Bereichen — im Measurement und noch stärker in Privacy Tech. Im Measurement sind wir die unabhängige Messinstanz neben den Kampagnen-Agenturen unserer Kunden: Wer die Kampagne verkauft, sollte nicht auch das Reporting dazu liefern. In Privacy Tech gibt es kaum spezialisierte Agenturen; Aufträge landen sonst bei großen IT-Häusern, die das Thema nebenbei mitmachen.

Bisher hat unser Geschäftsführer das Consulting-Team allein geführt. Das stößt an Grenzen. Deshalb suchen wir eine Person, die heute als Senior Consultant einsteigt und morgen mitführen will — und die bewusst in Hamburg sitzt, damit wir hier mehr Team werden.

description:
Mission

Neko Health is a health technology company that opened its first clinic in Stockholm in 2018, founded by Daniel Ek and Hjalmar Nilsonne.

In one hour, our scan combines radiation-free imaging, heart and circulation measurements, and same-visit blood results with time to talk it through with a clinician, so people can act on what matters before symptoms appear. We design and build our own hardware, software and clinical protocols, and more than 100,000 members have already had a scan, with 75% booking and prepaying their next one before they leave.

As a team, we chase 10X, not 10%, and we’re looking for people who think the same way to help us scale what we’ve started in Sweden, the UK, and now the US. Join the clinicians, engineers and business builders making prevention a routine part of care.

Role Purpose

This is not a traditional laboratory role. We're looking for a Biomedical Scientist who is comfortable working differently, embraces innovation, and takes pride in delivering accurate results at exceptional pace.

Neko Health members come through our clinics for whole-body preventive health screenings, and our laboratories sit at the centre of the patient journey. They are busy, modern spaces, and the service continues to develop as we scale.

This is a hands-on, autonomous role, based on site in one of our central London laboratories. As a Biomedical Scientist, you will operate our Abbott Alinity and Sysmex XN-550 analysers and support the quality systems that allow us to return results within 30 minutes of sample receipt.

If you're a BMS looking to further develop your career in an innovation-led environment, we would love to hear from you.

title: Senior ML Engineer
description:
SAEKI - Autonomous factories for the free world

SAEKI builds autonomous factories for the free world. Born in Switzerland and scaling from our factory in Munich, we deliver the most demanding mission-critical parts at a speed and volume traditional suppliers cannot match. Our software learns from every part we make and carries that knowledge into every machine and every factory we add. We are building the industrial base that ensures the free world outbuilds any rival.

We build factories that learn. We sell tangible parts, not software: every part we make produces data on design, cost, process and quality. Our bet is that a factory which learns from that data makes each next part faster, better and with fewer people, and that what one factory learns, every new factory applies.


The Role

You own the learn and apply steps of our knowledge loop: you say what data the key bet needs and turn it into decisions that engineers and operators use every week. Concretely, you will:

  • Identify the key bet: the decision in our factory, from quoting to quality, where learning from data pays off most
  • Define, with our software engineers, what data we capture from day one
  • Build the first learning-factory MVP yourself and put it in front of engineers and operators within weeks
  • Decide what to build, what to buy and when a model is good enough to trust
  • Show the company and our investors, with numbers, that the factory is learning
  • Grow into the AI Lead role once your MVPs are proven


What We're Looking For

  • Several years shipping ML or LLM systems that real users depended on
  • Stack: Strong Python, SQL and data engineering; comfortable from raw data to deployed tool
  • Experience starting from zero data: you have designed what to capture and then built a tool on it

title: Quality Control Technician – Semiconductor (m/f/d)
description:
Build Europe's semiconductor future with us!

Join us to build up one of Europe’s most advanced semiconductor manufacturing sites in Dresden. 
As a Quality Control Technician you serve as the final quality gate before our products reach global customers.  
In this role, you combine automated optical inspection (AVI), systematic defect review, and final documentation checks in a cutting-edge cleanroom facility. During your onboarding starting in February 2027, you will complete a 6-month training program in Taiwan to gain hands-on fab experience, master core inspection procedures, and build a strong international network.


Job Responsibilities

  • Operate optical inspection tools and manage Automated Visual Inspection recipes.
  • Perform detailed defect reviews, verify hold lots, and generate structured defect reports for engineering evaluation.
  • Validate outgoing wafer documentation and ensure strict compliance with quality, handling, and shipping standards.
  • Execute cleanroom environmental monitoring and support routine tool calibration and 6S audit processes.
  • Conduct initial troubleshooting on inspection equipment and execute lot disposition according to standard procedures.
  • Manage operational inventory of cleanroom parts, consumables, and Front Opening Shipping Boxes.
  • Handle manual packing and safe dispatch preparation of finished goods for warehouse transfer.
  • Work in rotating shift schedules (initially a 2-shift model, transitioning to a continuous 5-crew 3-shift roster).

Must Have:  

  • Completed technical vocational training (Berufsausbildung) or equivalent with technical background/aptitude.

title: Quality Assurance & Documentation Technician (m/f/d)
description:
Build Europe's semiconductor future with us!

Join us during the exciting build-up phase of one of Europe’s most advanced semiconductor manufacturing sites. As an MQR Technician at ESMC in Dresden, you play a central role in ensuring operational quality, accurate documentation, and process reliability. You bridge the gap between cleanroom operations, quality data analysis, and document management. In close collaboration with our engineering teams and international counterparts at TSMC HQ, you ensure that quality standards, offline calibration, and statistical process controls run smoothly from day one.


Job Responsibilities

  • Quality Data & Reporting: Support engineers by preparing preliminary reports, tracking SPC (Statistical Process Control) charts, and gathering data for Cpk and process health indices.
  • Document Control Management: Create, review, update, and archive quality- and production-related documents in compliance with international semiconductor standards.
  • Offline Calibration & Tool Management: Coordinate recalls, maintain calibration records, audit calibration status labels, and interface with external third-party calibration vendors.
  • Wafer Logistics & Cross-Fab Collaboration: Coordinate wafer shipments between ESMC and Taiwan fabs for qualification, testing, and quality defense.
  • Metrology & Tool Matching Support: Assist engineers with metrology tool gating, tool matching activities, and quality verification tasks.
  • Audit & Discrepancy Checks: Conduct regular checks on quality documents and system entries to detect and resolve discrepancies early.
  • Knowledge Transfer: Train junior team members and provide first-level support to internal users regarding the document management system.

title: Chemical Lab Technician – Semiconductor (m/f/d)
description:
Build Europe's semiconductor future with us!

Join us during the exciting build-up phase of one of Europe’s most advanced semiconductor manufacturing sites in Dresden. As a Chemical Laboratory Technician, you will ensure the highest purity standards across our manufacturing processes. Working with state-of-the-art analytical equipment, you will analyze chemicals, ultra-pure water, and cleanroom air impurities that directly safeguard our semiconductor yield. You bridge advanced trace analysis with active engineering support in a modern, 24/7 high-tech manufacturing environment.

  • Data Collection & Reporting: Evaluate test results, compile accurate data, and generate analytical quality reports for internal engineering teams and external partners.
  • Engineering Support: Collaborate with engineers on experimental design, method optimization, and new process qualifications.
  • Tool Maintenance & Calibration: Perform routine calibrations, basic maintenance, and quality gating to ensure maximum laboratory tool uptime.
  • Safety & Compliance: Uphold the highest laboratory safety protocols and maintain a clean, organized, and compliant workspace.
  • Shift Collaboration: Ensure seamless 24/7 lab support by working within a rotating day/night shift schedule.

title: AI Platform Engineer (f/m/d)
description:
About us

As a young company based in Hamburg’s beautiful Speicherstadt, we are on a mission to transform the transportation and logistics industry. We provide our customers with an innovative data platform to measure and reduce their greenhouse gas emissions and are passionate about minimizing the industry’s environmental impact and shaping a sustainable future. 
 
Since our founding in 2018, our team has grown continuously, and we have big plans ahead. Therefore, we are looking for motivated colleagues who want to change the world together with us. Be inspired and become part of our team!

  • Design, build, and maintain our AI agent platform, including multi-agent orchestration, tool integrations, context management, and agent execution.
  • Develop robust evaluation and testing frameworks for AI agents, including automated evals, regression testing, and quality monitoring.
  • Build observability for AI systems, covering execution tracing, reliability, latency, performance, and cost optimization.
  • Implement security and governance for agentic systems, including access controls, human-in-the-loop approvals, audit logging, and safe execution.
  • Build and maintain the infrastructure required to deploy, scale, and operate AI applications in production.

  • Enable engineering teams to adopt AI technologies through reusable tooling, best practices, and platform capabilities.


Your skills

  • 5+ years of experience in software engineering, platform engineering, DevOps, or related fields.

  • Build rigorous evaluations on public and internal benchmarks, and use them to drive decisions.

  • Collaborate with research and engineering colleagues to bring successful methods into production systems.

About Tritium Fuel Cycle (TFC)

GFG is designing a first-of-a-kind (FOAK) fusion power plant (FPP) to deliver 1 GW of electrical power in the 2040s. The “GIGA” plant will be based on a stellarator magnetic confinement fusion device, operating continuously on a deuterium-tritium (D-T) fuel cycle.  Prior to this, the smaller “Gauss Industrial Demonstrator (GID-170)” will be deployed in the mid-2030s.

While deuterium can be extracted from seawater, tritium is a tightly controlled radioactive isotope with an extremely limited global supply. Therefore, both GID-170 and GIGA must utilise closed tritium fuel cycle infrastructure, to ensure that unburnt tritium is fully recycled back to the stellarator and not released to the environment. Meanwhile, the tritium consumed by the fusion reaction must be replenished using tritium breeding blankets (TBB).

A first-of-a-kind dedicated tritium fuel cycle (TFC) facility, suitable for continuously supporting a stellarator device, must be designed, built and commissioned. It will adopt a multi-loop process architecture, each loop comprising many deeply integrated subsystems. Developing such a facility presents unique engineering challenges: the supply chain is still emerging, commercial process simulation tools lack dedicated TFC libraries, suitable off-the-shelf equipment is not always available, and some technologies have relatively low technology readiness levels (TRLs). 

A conceptual design is currently under development, with the project then progressing into pre-front-end engineering design (pre-FEED) in 2028, followed by front-end engineering design (FEED) and design for manufacturing phases. Completion of the overall design phase (for GID-170) must be achieved by 2032.

title: Working Student / Intern - Heating System
description:
WHO WE ARE

At Proxima Fusion, we’re driven by a bold mission – to redefine the future of sustainable energy. Our unique concept, built upon the groundbreaking W7-X stellarator and the latest advances in technology, paves the way for commercially viable fusion power plants. What’s more, our work in stellarator optimization, powered by cutting-edge computation and machine learning is propelling us into uncharted territories of fusion technology. New higher performance design points are unlocked by high temperature superconducting magnets and microwave tubes. To fully grasp this opportunity, we’re building a team of dedicated and passionate people who come together driving something extraordinary, radically transforming technology in the world.

WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION

You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world. You’ll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals. Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey. Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent.

YOUR IMPACT

Join Proxima’s Alpha Engineering team and tackle one of fusion’s toughest physical challenges: heating the Alpha stellarator to hundreds of millions of degrees, where it fuses and begins producing its own energy. Alpha is Proxima’s flagship machine—the world’s first high-temperature superconducting stellarator—designed to de-risk the technologies needed for Stellaris, our future fusion powerplant.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Carry out test and modeling of microwave components - building software to quantify performance and allow these components to be effectively validated

title: Electrical Engineer
description:
About pplwise
pplwise is a recruiting consultancy for fast-growing technology companies across Europe. Through Recruiting as a Service and Executive Search, we fill key roles for our clients, from start-ups to publicly listed companies. We are filling this position for our client Filics.

About our client: Filics
Filics is reinventing intralogistics with autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) that change how material moves. Its double-runner system makes Filics the first and only AMR that can drive through load carriers such as Euro pallets. This breaks with forklift logic and sets a new standard for efficiency. Filics is a small, hands-on team that solves hard problems with engineering excellence. Leadership goes to those who take initiative and consistently deliver. As Electrical Engineer (m/f/d) at Filics, you will design the electronics at the core of the next generation of robots.

About the role
This is an on-site/hybrid role in Munich, close to engineering and assembly.

Filics doesn’t just use off-the-shelf components. It builds its own custom IP. The robots run on advanced boards that cover a wide range of electrical engineering. On one end is high power, such as battery and motor controllers. On the other end are high-speed interfaces like PCIe, USB and MIPI CSI. The real challenge is making all these subsystems work together as one system. Many of these problems have no textbook solution. Solving them takes solid experience, a deep understanding of the physics and a creative mind.

The EE team is small, and the robot is far from finished. You’ll own your boards end to end: requirements, system design, schematic, layout, design review, sourcing, manufacturing, testing and validation. You’ll keep owning them for as long as they’re in production.

Filics is reinventing intralogistics with autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) that change how material moves. Its double-runner system makes Filics the first and only AMR that can drive through load carriers such as Euro pallets. This breaks with forklift logic and sets a new standard for efficiency. Filics is a small, hands-on team that solves hard problems with engineering excellence. Leadership goes to those who take initiative and consistently deliver. As Senior Electrical Engineer (m/f/d) at Filics, you will design the electronics at the core of the next generation of robots.

About the role
This is an on-site/hybrid role in Munich, close to engineering and assembly.

Filics doesn’t just use off-the-shelf components. It builds its own custom IP. The robots run on advanced boards that cover a wide range of electrical engineering. On one end is high power, such as battery and motor controllers. On the other end are high-speed interfaces like PCIe, USB and MIPI CSI. The real challenge is making all these subsystems work together as one system. Many of these problems have no textbook solution. Solving them takes solid experience, a deep understanding of the physics and a creative mind.

The EE team is small, and the robot is far from finished. You’ll own your boards end to end: requirements, system design, schematic, layout, design review, sourcing, manufacturing, testing and validation. You’ll keep owning them for as long as they’re in prod

QuantumDiamonds (QD) is a novel equipment vendor from Germany which builds novel magnetic field imaging systems based on quantum sensors. We spun out of TU Munich in 2022. We use nitrogen-vacancy (NV) centers in diamond to map electrical current with micrometer precision inside advanced 2.5D and 3D chips.

Nine of the world’s ten largest semiconductor manufacturers work with us, and our systems run in Europe, the US and Asia. We are investing €152 million in the world’s first production facility for quantum-based semiconductor inspection, in Munich, supported under the European Chips Act. Our international team of 80+ physicists, engineers and data scientists works side by side.

 

What you bring

  • Ownership: you take responsibility for your work, follow topics through to completion and care about outcomes.

  • Curiosity and a learning mindset: you ask questions and keep deepening your understanding of quantum technology and its applications.

The company offers end-to-end solutions for protecting homes and businesses оf any scale. Der Plan steht, jetzt fehlst du: Bring unsere Software von Legacy-PHP auf Symfony und React.

Auf einen Blick

  • Stack: PHP 8.1 (Legacy) → Symfony · jQuery/Vanilla-JS → React · MySQL/MariaDB, SingleStore · Git, CI/CD

Wohin es gehen soll, ist klar: Das Backend wird schrittweise auf Symfony umgestellt, das Frontend auf React vereinheitlicht. Bis Ende 2027 soll die Migration abgeschlossen sein. Was dafür fehlt, ist kein Plan, sondern Kapazität.

Du triffst eigenständig technische Entscheidungen, bringst dich in Architektur- und Modernisierungsfragen ein und sorgst dafür, dass die Codequalität mit jedem Release besser wird. Dabei bleibt das Produkt im Einsatz: Wartung, Support und neue Features laufen parallel zur Modernisierung.

description:
Senior Product Engineer

 

Can you help us fix the world's most broken supply chain?

The fashion industry produces over 100 billion garments a year. 60% end up in landfill, not because people don't want these clothes, but because the supply chain for getting secondhand fashion from donation to resale is completely offline, manual, and broken.

Fleek is fixing this. Our mission is to make secondhand the first choice. We're building the infrastructure powering the global secondhand clothing trade, through a B2B marketplace and the AI systems digitising the supply chain behind it.

Through Fleek, vintage stores, online resellers, and retail buyers source graded secondhand inventory directly from wholesalers and rag houses across multiple countries. Our key enabler is FleekSort, an AI model fine-tuned on secondhand fashion, that can grade, price, and categorise items with just a photo, turning what has historically been an opaque and manual trade into a structured, searchable, and tradable global inventory layer.

Since 2022, we've saved 9 million items from landfill while tripling in size year-on-year. We're backed by some of the world's best investors, including a16z, Y Combinator, and HV Capital, alongside world-class angels who helped build Depop, Shopify, and Postmates.

Today, we serve thousands of resellers and retailers across the UK, Europe, and the US. With the secondhand fashion market projected to reach $350B by 2027, Fleek is building the AI-native operational and financial backbone for secondhand commerce globally.

We're looking for people who want to build something that matters, and move fast doing it. Sound good? Keep reading.

Vor 5,5 Jahren saßen wir zu zweit in einer WG in Düsseldorf. Kein Büro, kein Umsatz, keine Kunden. Nur ein Telefon.

Heute sind wir 35 Leute auf knapp 900 m² Office. Rügamer & Steiner ist eine E-Mail- und CRM-Marketing-Agentur für E-Commerce: Wir helfen Onlineshops, mehr Umsatz aus ihren Bestandskunden zu holen – mit E-Mail-Marketing, WhatsApp, Printmailings und datengetriebenem CRM. Für über 150 Shops steuern wir so über 200 Mio. € Jahresumsatz mit. Unser eigener Umsatz liegt im mittleren einstelligen Millionenbereich und hat sich seit der Gründung jedes Jahr verdoppelt.

Alles davon ist aus Telefonaten entstanden. Kein Marketing, keine Brand, kein Content. Erst haben wir selbst telefoniert, heute tut es ein 6-köpfiges Sales-Team, das gerade auf 10 wächst.

title: CAD or Blender Expert for Recorded Design Tasks
description:
We’re looking for CAD professionals and Blender artists to create and record examples of design work for an AI project. You can specialize in either area.

You’ll propose tasks based on your experience and complete them in your usual software. During each task session, a recording tool will capture your screen, keyboard and mouse activity. We’ll coordinate the recording setup with you before you start.

Tasks

Tasks could include:

  • CAD: Creating a part from a dimensioned drawing, modifying an existing model or completing an assembly.
  • Blender: Modeling an object, adjusting materials and lighting, or preparing a scene to match a reference.

For each task, you’ll write a short brief explaining the requested work and expected result. You’ll also provide the starting files where applicable, the final editable project and any requested exports.

Requirements

You should have professional experience with software such as Autodesk Fusion, SolidWorks, AutoCAD or Blender. You’ll need to work independently and communicate clearly in English. Previous experience with AI projects isn’t required.

title: Technical Support Specialist
description:
Headquarters:  Canada - Remote
 

 Our team is committed to enhancing physician and patient quality of life through Elation, a SaaS cloud-based clinical platform. Since inception, we've been focused on building a delightful, world-class experience that empowers physicians to deliver phenomenal care to patients. 
 Customer support has been the same job for twenty years: a queue, a ticket, an SLA, a closed case. That's ending, fast. Over the next 6–9 months, AI will take on more of the routine, repetitive cases at Elation. That doesn't shrink the human role — it builds on it. The work becomes product intelligence: shaping how AI handles conversations, holding the customer-trust moments that need real judgment, and turning patterns into priorities Engineering delivers. 
 We're hiring  Technical Support Specialists  to anchor that shift: people who don't just close tickets, but build the systems that eliminate them, design how AI handles conversations, and turn customer patterns into product priorities. 
 You might’ve been the person on a team who builds the dashboards, automations, or workflows that make everyone else better from a Support, Implementation, CS Ops, or Analyst seat. Now you want to formalize that work as the role itself. As a Technical Support Specialist, you'll bring empathy and judgment to the cases that need it most, own the quality of AI-driven solutions in your domain, and synthesize patterns that influence Product and Engineering roadmaps. We hire for judgment, taste, and curiosity, not process adherence. The bar isn't  how many cases you closed ; it's  how much you reshaped the conditions under which cases happen . 
 Role and Responsibilities 
 
  Use Good Judgment to Solve Cases.  Own customer escalations with cases that genuinely require seasoned judgment, the ones AI can't safely close. Build and protect customer trust in moments that matter. 
  Build and own AI quality.  Configure AI within Elation's stack (intents, knowledge sources, escalation rules), build lightweight external automations, and own the quality of AI outputs in your domain. 
  Synthesize and partner with Product/Eng.  Produce formal weekly and monthly insights, participate in roadmap conversations with Product Development teams, and mentor Associates on their build and synthesis work. 
 
 What success looks like in your first 6 months 
 
 Shipped 3–5 AI solutions 
 A monthly drumbeat of synthesized insights that Product and Engineering act on, with visible impact on customer experience or a measurable drop in case volume 
 Owns a measurable case-volume reduction in your domain by making cases not happen, not by closing them faster 
 You question default workflows instead of just executing them, and you ship more by removing work, not just doing more of it. 
 You build with AI to make yourself  and the teammates around you  faster — automating triage, drafting responses, prototyping internal tools, and  turning one-off builds into reusable pattern

Our hotel partners across Asia are mid-shift while our UK team sleeps — and we're looking for a Customer Success Associate to be the in-region contact who picks up their questions and issues in their own time zone.

 The role at a glance   Title: Customer Success Associate  Location: Remote, based in Singapore (nearby APAC time zones considered), working mostly APAC hours  Compensation: £35,000 – £37,000 per year  Contract: 2-year contract  Team: Customer Success (APAC & Middle East pod), reporting to the Enterprise Customer Success Manager  
This is an associate-level customer success role on our APAC & Middle East team, and it's built around two things.

  You'll be our our in-region first response. When a property hits a problem overnight UK time, you pick it up, work with the hotel team and our in-region support, and hand the UK team a clear head start — rather than the hotel waiting for London to wake up.  You'll own the day-to-day relationship with our standard properties across a region of more than 120 hotels and 13 brands. That means support follow-through, re-onboarding properties that need it, and making sure every hotel gets real value from our platform.  
Enterprise and Growth accounts sit with the Enterprise Customer Success Manager. You'll shadow and support that work as you learn, and take on more over time; this role is the in-region contact for standard properties.

You'll communicate with hoteliers the way great hoteliers talk to their guests. Every message is written by you, with care. You'll work mostly in APAC hours, with some overlap into UK afternoons — more at the start. You'll sit in a small regional pod alongside Product Solutions, Support and Sales, with property teams from front office to GM as your day-to-day contacts.

title: Principal Data Scientist
description:
At CoMind, we are developing a non-invasive neuromonitoring technology that will result in a new era of clinical brain monitoring. In joining us, you will be helping to create cutting-edge technologies that will improve how we diagnose and treat brain disorders, ultimately improving and saving the lives of patients across the world.

The Role

The Data Science team at CoMind develops the algorithms and machine learning systems that transform raw optical interference signals from CoMind One into continuous, clinically meaningful measurements of cerebral blood flow, intracranial pressure, and autoregulation. Working at the frontier of photonics, physiology, and applied ML, the team's work directly determines what CoMind One can measure, how accurately, and under what clinical conditions.

As Principal Data Scientist, you will be a technical authority for CoMind's data science function, setting methodological direction for signal condition and extraction, personally driving the most complex and highest-impact problems, and providing expert guidance on data science best practice across the team. This is a senior individual contributor role: you will not manage people directly, but your technical leadership will shape how the entire team approaches its most challenging problems. You will work closely with R&D, Clinical, and Software Engineering.

At CoMind, all team members work at least 4 days per week from our new Kings Cross offices, plus a flexible work-from-home day.

title: Welding Sales Manager
description:
About Standard Bots

Standard Bots is America's largest manufacturer of AI-native industrial robots. Full-stack robots—hardware, software, and AI—all designed and assembled in Glen Cove, New York. The company makes AI-native robots anyone can buy and deploy, with customers ranging from family-owned machine shops to the Fortune 500. Customers include Sunoco, Lockheed Martin, NASA, and the U.S. Army, along with hundreds of manufacturers nationwide. Standard Bots raised a $200 million Series C at a $1 billion valuation from RoboStrategy, General Catalyst, Amazon Industrial Innovation Fund, and Samsung Next.

About the role

Fabricators across the country can't hire enough welders, and you know it better than most, because you've run a torch yourself. As our Welding Sales Manager, you'll show shops what cobot welding does for their throughput, quality, and people, and you'll own the national welding number. Welding is one of our fastest-growing applications, and you'll be the person who helps it grow even faster.

📍 Location

This role is remote within the United States, and we prefer candidates in NYC metro, North Carolina, California, Illinois or Texas. Expect to travel frequently to customer sites, regional teams, trade shows, and partners (~50% domestic travel).

What you'll do

- Own the welding number. You carry the national quota for welding systems and revenue across direct and partner sales. You build and manage the welding pipeline and forecast with each region, and you measure success by installed, producing systems, not just bookings.

- Partner with Regional Sales Managers. You co-sell welding opportunities with RSMs in every territory, from discovery through close. That means welding-specific discovery, part and joint reviews, and ROI conversations with fabricators. You'll join customer site visits, demos, and weld trials alongside our Welding Applications Engineers, and you'll raise the welding knowledge of the broader sales team through training, deal reviews, and ride-alongs.

- Sell direct MIG welding systems. You help shops evaluate cobot MIG welding against their part mix, volumes, and labor constraints, and you lead the proposals, pricing, and negotiation on welding deals.

- Build the partner channel. You recruit and manage gas and welding distributors as a lead source for Standard Bots welding. You also support partner-built solutions, such as laser welding cells, from the first conversation to repeatable sales.

- Be the voice of the welding customer. You bring field feedback on ease of use, features, and competitive gaps to the welding product team, and you represent Standard Bots at welding and fabrication trade shows and industry events.

What you'll bring

- Hands-on welding

Über uns

Probantica ist ein Anbieter für Qualitätstests aus Köln. Wir prüfen im Auftrag von Unternehmen, ob digitale Produkte und Abläufe vor Ort im Alltag funktionieren. Die Tests machen bei uns angestellte Qualitätsmanager:innen – Menschen mit Vertrag, fester Ansprechperson und klaren Vorgaben.

Worum es geht

Unternehmen müssen wissen, ob ihre Apps, Websites und Filialen im Alltag wirklich funktionieren. Als Kunde gehst du die angebotenen Abläufe durch: App öffnen, Konto anlegen, Formular ausfüllen, Bestellung abschließen, in eine Filiale gehen. Du testest den Prozess von Anfang bis Ende, dokumentierst jeden Schritt mit Uhrzeit und Screenshot und markierst die Stellen, an denen etwas hakt oder unklar bleibt.

Vor jedem Auftrag bekommst du eine Anleitung mit Schritten, Zeitrahmen und den Fragen, die am Ende beantwortet sein müssen. Kein Rätselraten, kein Vertrieb, keine Kaltakquise. Getestet wird auf deinem eigenen Gerät, in deiner Nähe.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Digitale Produkte testen: App, Website oder Online-Prozess einmal vollständig durchlaufen – von der Anmeldung bis zum Abschluss.
  • Abläufe vor Ort prüfen: in Filialen, Shops oder Servicestellen, mit Blick auf Wartezeit, Beratung und Abwicklung.
  • Auffälligkeiten festhalten: Screenshot machen, Uhrzeit notieren, in zwei bis fünf Sätzen beschreiben, was passiert ist.
  • Bericht einreichen: die vorgegebenen Fragen beantworten, Dauer je Schritt angeben, Ergebnis knapp zusammenfassen.
  • Nachfragen beantworten: wenn das Team zu einem Befund etwas wissen möchte, kurz und sachlich antworten.

Das bringst du mit

  • Du bist mindestens 18 Jahre alt.
  • Du hast ein Smartphone oder einen Laptop mit Internetzugang – Geräte für App- und Website-Tests stellst du selbst.
  • Du drückst dich in klaren, verständlichen Sätzen aus und arbeitest sorgfältig.
  • Du hältst Termine ein und meldest dich, wenn etwas nicht klappt.

The opportunity

Demand for AI compute is outrunning the infrastructure to deliver it, and the environmental bill is growing with it: more fossil power, more freshwater, more land. New capacity on land also means waiting years for power, sites and permits.

We take a different route: we bring compute to the power. Far offshore, the wind blows stronger and steadier than anywhere on land, and no grid will ever reach it. Using it lets AI scale without adding carbon or competing with communities and nature for water and land.

description:
Dates : 6 mois à partir de février ou mars 2027

Contexte du projet :

L’allègement des structures automobiles reste un levier majeur pour réduire la consommation et les émissions des véhicules, tout en répondant à des exigences croissantes de rigidité et de tenue au crash. Les pièces de caisse en blanc sont en grande majorité réalisées à partir de tôles d’acier mises en forme, dont la conception repose encore largement sur l’expertise et sur des itérations successives entre calcul et dessin.

L’optimisation topologique permet de déterminer la meilleure répartition de matière dans un domaine de conception donné. Appliquée à un domaine volumique 3D, elle conduit cependant à des structures massives ou de type treillis, difficilement transposables en pièces embouties d’épaisseur quasi constante. Le défi scientifique consiste à formuler une méthode capable de faire émerger, à partir d’un domaine volumique, des géométries représentatives de tôles (structures à parois minces), en maîtrisant l’épaisseur et la fabricabilité, sous chargements statiques puis dynamiques.

Ce stage s’inscrit dans le cadre d’une collaboration de recherche entre le LTDS et ArcelorMittal Global R&D. Il a vocation à se poursuivre par une thèse CIFRE en cas de résultats concluants.

L’objectif du stage sera de développer et d’évaluer une première méthodologie d’optimisation topologique 3D aboutissant à une solution en tôle d’acier, en s’appuyant sur une structure automobile.

Les missions pourront comprendre :

•Un état de l’art des méthodes d’optimisation topologique conduisant à des structures minces de type coque (contrôle d’épaisseur par filtrage et projection, contraintes de longueur caractéristique, approches par composants explicites ou level-set).

•Le développement d’un algorithme d’optimisation 3D appliqué à une pièce automobile soumise à des chargements statiques.

title: Senior Motor Fleet Underwriter
description:
About Flock

Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we’re changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time.

We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK’s leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We’re growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we’re hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead.

We’re on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us!

 

About the role

As a Senior Motor Fleet Underwriter, you’ll manage and grow a large portfolio of fleet business, using data and AI to assess risk and tailor cover to each client. You’ll help us move into new segments, including emerging mobility, as we build one of the UK’s largest fleet MGAs. You’ll report to our Head of Motor Underwriting.

You’ll work closely with brokers, mentor junior underwriters and help shape our products, wording and processes. AI is part of the underwriting process itself: you’ll use it to pull risk data out of submissions and triage cases faster, leaving your time for the judgement calls that need an experienced underwriter.

 

What you’ll be doing

  • Manage and develop a large portfolio of motor fleet business and contribute strongly to team targets.

Relay sees the last mile through couriers' own devices: GPS traces from live deliveries that show where they park, which entrance they use and how long each handover takes. Turning those traces into a trusted picture of the real last mile is the foundation the rest of our Science builds on.

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

  • One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people

  • Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

  • Profitable since 2017

  • Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

  • Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

  1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

  2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relen

title: Growth Associate
description:
Our Mission
Human time and effort is the rarest thing in the universe. The fact that so many people hate what they do for work is a disaster on so many levels. How many people live quiet lives of misery? How many generational talents do we miss due to circumstance?

Dex’s mission is to close the gap between Talent & Opportunity, we believe that work, and being productive, is part of the human condition, that regardless of AI, human passion, ingenuity and a desire to do things means that work will always exist.

We are building Dex to create a future where technology helps every individual to understand their strengths, interests and unique abilities, and to connect with opportunities where they can thrive, because more people doing things they love leads to a better, happier and more productive world.

We are starting by connecting the world's most ambitious software engineers with the companies that deserve them.

About Dex

Dex is backed by Notion Capital, a16z and Concept Ventures, with angels from OpenAI, Wise, ElevenLabs, Meta’s board, and many more. We’re an ambitious, direct and kind group of people, we value authenticity, ambition and people who make things happen.

We’re a team of 28 (and growing) based in London. We work together 3 times a week because we value in person time, but we’re person centric and flexible. We hire adults who can manage their own schedules.

The Role

40,000+ engineers have joined Dex, and we plan to 10x that in the next year. To get there we’re building a growth engine: channels, tools and agents that find the right engineers and get better every week. This role helps build and run it.

It’s a broad role
