title: Inside Sales Associate, Partnerships
description:
At Cogstate, we’re advancing the science of brain health - making it faster, easier, and more accurate to assess cognition across clinical trials, healthcare settings, and everyday life.

Our digital cognitive assessments are trusted by researchers, clinicians, and pharmaceutical partners around the world, helping to drive breakthroughs in neuroscience and improve outcomes for people living with neurological conditions. Founded on decades of cognitive science and backed by rigorous validation, Cogstate’s assessments are used in more than 150 countries and over 2,000 clinical trials.

Our global team of experts - spanning psychology, data science, operations, and technology - works together to solve complex challenges in brain health assessment, always with a patient-first mindset. Whether we’re supporting a multinational Alzheimer’s trial or developing tools to bring cognitive testing into routine care, our work is meaningful, collaborative, and constantly evolving.

At Cogstate, we’re not just imagining the future of brain health - we’re building it.

That’s why we’re seeking a Inside Sales Coordinator, Partnerships accountable for managing and qualifying inbound sales opportunities generated through strategic partners and referral channels (primarily CRO and eCOA partners). This individual will serve as the central coordinator between partners, proposals, business development, science, operations and finance teams to ensure opportunities are fully qualified and move efficiently through the proposal and sales process.

Primary responsibilities include: developing relationships with Cogstate partners, qualification of inbound opportunities, coordination of budget development and proposal generation, maintenance of accurate opportunity tracking within Salesforce, facilitation of communication among internal stakeholders, and proactive follow-up activities in coordination with Business Development Directors to help manage sales process and improve win rates. The Inside Sales Associate may also be involved in outbound sales activity as directed by the Chief Commercial Officer in partnership with BD Directors.

This role is ideal for an individual who is extremely organized, enjoys managing multiple opportunities simultaneously, collaborating across functions, and actively working with external partners to help convert partner referrals into revenue-generating contracts.

Key Responsibilities

  • Receive and manage inbound opportunities from strategic partners, including eCOA vendors, CROs, technology alliances, and other referral sources.
  • Coordinate with BD Directors and conduct initial qualification to assess:
    • Sponsor name (or geographic location at minimum)
    • Management of mutual CDA agreements
    • Study specifications (including protocol synopsis if possible)

title: Sales Director
description:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data. Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on. Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions. As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact. During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

About the Role

We’re looking to hire an Enterprise Sales Director to join the Revenue Team. This person will be responsible for building out our enteprise customer base within various regions in Japan. The ideal person will be a proactive and curious member of our growing Sales team, identifying new business with prospects and growth opportunities for clients. A certain level of foresight and knowledge working with intrinsic sales cycles will take this individual confidently into the future of dbt Labs.

What You'll Do

  • 6+ years closing experience in technology sales, with a proven track record of exceeding annual targets

  • Ability to understand complex technical concepts and develop them into a consultative sale

  • Excellent verbal, written, and in-person communication skills to engage stakeholders at all levels of an analytics organization (individual developer up to CTO)

  • The diligence and organizational skills to work long, intricate sales cycles involving multiple client teams

  • Ability to operate in an ambiguous and fast-paced work environment

title: Regional Sales Director, Singapore
description:
Join the company that’s building the telemetry infrastructure for the AI era. At Cribl, we partner with IT and Security teams at many of the world’s biggest enterprises, including half of the Fortune 100, to bridge the gap between AI ambition and infrastructure reality. As the AI Platform for Telemetry, we give customers the choice, control, and flexibility to manage and analyze telemetry for both humans and agents, so they can build what’s next.

We’re one of the fastest‑growing private companies and a leading player in a massive, fast‑moving market. With a global workforce, we’re remote‑first and grounded in a simple idea: software is a people business. Cribl is the place where curious, collaborative people can do their best work, grow fast, and bring their full selves to the herd.

Why You’ll Love This Role

As a Sales Director at Cribl, you’ll lead, support, and inspire a diverse team of geographically aligned Regional Sales Managers. Your focus will be on attracting top talent, nurturing growth, and empowering your team to excel in both new logo acquisition and account expansion—consistently exceeding ambitious quarterly and annual goals. This is more than a leadership role; it’s a unique opportunity to drive meaningful impact and fuel Cribl’s continued success.

Please note, this is a remote role based out of Singapore.


As An Active Member Of Our Team, You Will...

  • Recruit, develop and lead a team of 5-7 Enterprise Sales Reps across a specific geography
  • Building a sales team and the future sales leaders of Cribl
  • Develop a business plan to overachieve sales goals
  • Manage and maintain sales ecosystem from generating leads through closing
  • You will be part of a proven leadership team and play a key role in developing the GTM. Reporting to the VP of Sales
  • We are a remote-first company and work happens across many time-zones – you may be required to occasionally perform duties outside your standard working hours

If You’ve Got It - We Want It

  • Minimum 5 years of leading Enterprise sales teams
  • Experience scaling and growing an Singapore team
  • A successful track record of overachievement annually
  • Experience leading sales team who sell through security channel partners
  • Experience navigating complex sales cycles
  • Experience with SAAS sales - cloud, logs, metrics, IT operations and security
  • Background of successfully selling large deals to large enterprises (Fortune 1000)
  • Background using MEDDIC and Command of Message
  • Experience developing pipeline and opening new accounts
  • Bonus points/Preferred Skills:
    • Background in Cloud, Security, or Machine Learning
    • Nice to have iRAP

When you join us, you will be integrated into a cooperative and encouraging team, participate in challenging yet critical work, and experience ongoing growth opportunities to help you achieve your full potential. Visit our website to learn more.

As a Sales Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in driving sustainable business growth by establishing and nurturing customer relationships, providing technical expertise, and promoting our innovative fluid management solutions across the Life Sciences market - specifically this role will be driving our product portfolio across Upstream Bioprocessing applications.
You will be responsible for identifying and engaging potential customers, managing a robust pipeline of opportunities, and supporting key account growth through consultative sales practices. The role involves frequent interaction with customers, including on-site visits and virtual demonstrations, to showcase the features and benefits of our cutting-edge products.
 
Your ability to work autonomously, travel extensively, and adapt to dynamic challenges will ensure success in this impactful role.
 
Key Responsibilities:
  • Account Management: Establish a and maintain a sustainable pipeline of potential opportunities by growing key customers and high-growth industries within Upstream Bioprocessing.

title: Software Engineer, Simulation (Digital Twins)
description:
Our Mission

At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient.

We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today!

The Role

Every site we map becomes a digital twin, built from our own lidar maps, and in it our robots see thousands of the intrusions, fires and sensor failures a real site sees once a year. Our multi-robot patrol policy was trained in simulation in under two hours on a single GPU and ran unmodified on real robots at three sites. Your job is to make that repeatable for every site and every new skill.

You will work with our Skills & Orchestration engineers, who train learned skills with reinforcement learning, and with our Reliability & Test Infrastructure engineer, who runs regression in the same simulator.

What You'll Work On

  • Map to twin: a pipeline from our lidar maps to simulation-ready digital twins: geometry, semantics, materials, sensors.

  • Training environments: RL environments for learned skills such as multi-robot patrol and search, randomised so nothing overfits one site.

The Role

You will own the research question at the centre of LEA, our foundation model of the physical world: can a model learn what normally happens on a site, by place, hour and weather, so that an anomaly is simply what it did not expect? The first version is a probabilistic memory of each site. The next is a world model across every site that predicts the next state in latent space, starting from open world-model weights and growing on field data nobody else holds.

Our robots and cameras run on live security sites around the clock, and every event is kept with its clip, the model's verdict and the operator's outcome. That record is your dataset. You will work alongside our perception and model engineers, and your results go into production, not only into papers.

  • Site memory: a learned, probabilistic model of each site: which people, vehicles and robots are where, at what hour, in what weather, and how the scene usually unfolds.

Over MyWheels

MyWheels gelooft in een toekomst waarin je mobiliteit inricht op wat je écht nodig hebt, niet op wat je bezit. Toegang tot de juiste auto, op het juiste moment. Wij bouwen het platform dat dat mogelijk maakt.

Je werkt mee aan onze processen en verwerkingen, en verdiept je in de Leidraad Data Delen van de ACM, die praktische richtlijnen geeft over hoe de Europese Data Act door Nederlandse bedrijven moet worden uitgevoerd. Je werkt nauw samen met onze Security Lead, die je begeleidt, en kunt steunen op zijn contacten met onze Functionaris Gegevensbescherming en de Legal Counsel van onze moedermaatschappij.

title: Werkstudent HR (m/w/d)
description:
Die Daikin Refrigerants Frankfurt GmbH mit Sitz in Frankfurt am Main ist eine 100 %ige Tochter der Daikin Chemical Europe GmbH und damit der Daikin Industries Ltd., mit Sitz in Osaka Japan, zugehörig. Die Daikin Gruppe mit weltweit über 100.000 Mitarbeitern ist ein führender Hersteller von Klima- und Kühlgeräten sowie von fluorhaltigen Chemikalien. Neben einer Anlage zur Feindestillation des Pharma-Treibmittels S227 Pharma, welches weltweit in Dosier-Aerosolen für die Verabreichung medizinischer Wirkstoffe (e.g. Sprays gegen Asthma und COPD) eingesetzt wird, betreibt Daikin seit 2020 auch eine Aufbereitungsanlage zur Reinigung rückgewonnener fluorierter technischer Gase (HFKW), so dass diese anschließend erneut zum Einsatz in Klima- und Kühlgeräten eingesetzt werden können. Zudem verfügt der Standort über eine thermische Spaltanlage zur schadlosen Entsorgung von FCKW, HFKW und FKW. Mittels Wasserstoff-Sauerstoffflamme werden die Gase in Spaltreaktoren zu Fluss- und Salzsäure umgewandelt und als Rohstoffe wieder in den Wertstoffkreislauf zurückgeführt.

title: Testingenieur*in Elektromechanik / Hardware Test Engineer
description:
Wie wäre es, wenn deine Tests nicht das Ende der Entwicklung wären – sondern der Anfang? Mit Methodik, Präzision und der Freiheit, Schwachstellen aufzudecken, bevor sie zum Problem werden.

Wir bei TWK entwickeln und produzieren seit über 60 Jahren im Wachstumsmarkt der Mess- und Automatisierungstechnik kundenspezifische Sensoren für den Anlagen- und Maschinenbau. Funktionale Sicherheit für Mensch und Maschine ist unser Anspruch- oberflächliche Tests oder fehlende statistische Absicherung werden dem nicht gerecht. Deshalb legen wir Wert auf eine methodische und nachvollziehbare Testdurchführung und entwickeln diesen Bereich gezielt weiter.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams am Standort Düsseldorf suchen wir dich zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt in Vollzeit als Spezifikations- und Testingenieur*in.

Aufgaben

In vielen Unternehmen wird Testing als Anhängsel der Entwicklung angesehen oder man glaubt, KI könne alles ersetzen, statt erst einmal die richtigen Probleme zu identifizieren. Bei uns ist das anders: Du wirst frühzeitig in die Produktentwicklung eingebunden und begleitest den gesamten Prozess – von Spezifikationen und Anforderungen über Tests und Verifikation bis zur Zertifizierung. Dabei trägst du Verantwortung für die Zuverlässigkeit und Leistungsfähigkeit unserer elektromechanischen Komponenten. Du stimmst dich eng mit den Entwicklungsingenieuren ab, verfeinerst gemeinsam Spezifikationen und bringst deine Ergebnisse direkt in Produktentscheidungen ein. Analytisch, pragmatisch und auf Augenhöhe – wer eine bessere Lösung sieht, spricht sie an.

So sieht deine Arbeit konkret aus:

  • Spezifikation und Pflege von Anforderungen, Testfällen und Testplänen nach geltenden Normen und Produktanforderungen
  • Durchführung von Tests sowie Analyse und Dokumentation der Ergebnisse – beispielsweise Integrations-, Funktions-, Grenz-, Fehlerfall- und Klimatests
  • Entwicklung von Testaufbaute

About the Customer Digital Experience Team  
 Customer Digital Experience sits within the technical arm of Mixpanel's Customer Success organization. 
 Our sharpest focus is the digital-only segment: thousands of companies with no proactive account coverage. Some have technical resources available to them, but that support is entirely reactive. description:
About GiveDirectly

What if the most effective way to fight poverty was also the simplest: give people money and trust them to decide what they need?

Since 2011, GiveDirectly has proven that idea at scale. We’ve delivered more than $1B in cash directly to 2+ million people living in poverty and crisis across 15 countries, and rigorous research shows the results: healthier kids, stronger businesses, sturdier homes, and more resilient families and local economies. Cash is now widely recognized as one of the most scalable, cost-effective, and dignified forms of aid.

Our ambition goes beyond our own programs. We want cash to become the benchmark for aid, much as the index fund became the benchmark for investing, so that every aid dollar is held to one question: is this doing more good than giving the money directly to people living in poverty?

We’re growing fast, and this is a rare and important moment to join.

We expect to hit $1B in revenue in 2026 with significant growth forecast for 2027. At the same time we are building a new technology stack and operating model designed for a roughly 10x change in scale, and we are actively pursuing partnerships with major funders to move even more money in bigger ways, to people who need it. title: Forward Deployed AI Engineer (m/f/d) – Multi-Agent Systems
description:
Anyone can build an AI agent demo these days. Getting agents to run reliably in production, for thousands of users worldwide, is a different story. That's the job.

For a renowned automotive manufacturer in Munich, we are looking for an AI Engineer to take an existing AI innovation platform to the next level. title: Cryogenics Engineer – Test Facility & Auxiliary Cryoplants
description:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

 

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

 

BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO

  • Shape the architecture of the world’s first commercial fusion power plant – Own system-level decisions that determine how a first-of-a-kind energy technology is designed, integrated, and ultimately deployed at scale.

  • Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges – Work across tightly coupled disciplines (plasma physics, magnets, cryogenics, manufacturing, controls, and more) to resolve critical trade-offs and turn cutting-edge science into a functioning product.

title: Pricing & Deal Desk Manager (m/f/d)
description:
At Moss, we give finance professionals the power to automate their day-to-day and make forward-thinking decisions.

Our culture is what makes that possible: we play to win, we obsess over quality, and we win as One Moss, and it works. Moss closed a €35 million Series C in August 2026, crossing a €1 billion valuation, and became one of Europe's fintech unicorns. Join us for what's next.

We're hiring a Pricing & Deal Desk Manager within the Revenue Operations team. You'd take ownership of one of Moss's highest-leverage commercial functions: the pricing deal desk. It's already delivered real results, and it matters more every quarter as deal volume grows and Moss moves into bigger, more complex deals.

What makes the role unusual is that the desk already runs on AI. An agent picks up each request, pulls the deal's scoring and call history, calculates margin, and drafts a reasoned reply; you approve, correct, or overrule it. So the job is two things at once: the reviewer who decides live deals, and the person who builds & improves the AI-based deal desk agent

Your responsibilities

  • Own the day-to-day approval flow for non-standard pricing, discounts, and commercial terms, acting as the fast, consistent escalation point for reps without slowing deals down.

  • Build and evolve pricing governance, including discount rules, approval thresholds, and playbooks, converting recurring exceptions into documented policy.

  • Drive deal health across the funnel: discount discipline, price realization, deal structure, and win rate by segment, diagnosing where deals leak value and fixing it.

Engine Behind 120M Processed Auctions Daily

The Ad Network team builds and operates the backend services that power adjoe Ads' programmatic advertising engine. The core challenge is straightforward to state and hard to solve: for every incoming ad request from a mobile SDK, decide within milliseconds whether it's a good fit for any active campaign — and at what price to bid.

The stack runs on Kubernetes, with Kafka handling event streaming, DynamoDB and Elasticache powering low-latency data access, and Prometheus and Grafana providing observability across the entire system.

title: Founding sales lead
description:
Who are we?

The sea is the physical layer of the economy: our energy, data and trade move across it and under it. It is also Europe's most exposed flank. Cheap underwater drones, divers and mines now threaten ports, naval bases, subsea cables and offshore energy sites, and most of what is funded today stops at detection: it tells you a drone has entered the harbour, not how to stop it before it reaches the hull or the cable.

Pelagon is creating the category of maritime interdiction: detection and action together. We design, deploy and operate protection zones around critical maritime infrastructure: a persistent sensing network running our own acoustic-first AI detects and classifies threats, and an underwater interceptor acts on them.

We sell to navies and coast guards, and to the civilian operators of ports, subsea cables and offshore energy.

Pelagon was founded by Aymeric de Pontbriand (serial deeptech entrepreneur, founded and exited Scortex) and Gauthier Bouxin (French Navy officer, then McKinsey). A team is already in place around them: a lead embedded systems engineer, a lead hardware engineer and an a chief of staff. We are backed by Hexa, the pioneer startup studio in Europe behind Front, Aircall and Spendesk.

⚡ What is at stake in the coming months

Dans son prolongement, Sézane prend vie en 2013 : la première marque de mode française née en ligne. Puis sont venus enrichir cet univers : Octobre Éditions pour les hommes, Les Composantes, dédiée cette fois à l’art de vivre, et Petit Sézane pour les enfants.

Tout s’est construit comme on avance dans la vie : par élans, par gestes spontanés avec cette manière d’apprendre en faisant. Une autre relation au détail, au service et au lien. Une autre manière d’habiller le réel, d’abord en ligne, puis à travers nos Appartements.

Nous recherchons aujourd’hui des talents créatifs, structurés et agiles qui partagent l’envie d’améliorer sans cesse tout ce qui peut l’être. Des talents passionnés, autonomes qui conçoivent le travail dans le respect des autres et pour qui rien n'est hors d'atteinte, pour peu qu'on s'en donne les moyens.

Nous recherchons les talents d’un(e) Assistant(e) Chef(fe) de Projets Spéciaux (H/F) pour rejoindre notre équipe Marketing à l’occasion d’un stage de 6 mois à partir de Décembre 2026.

title: Head of Software
description:
We can't hire everyone… but we can help them shine somewhere brilliant.

At Octopus, we're lucky to attract some incredibly talented humans. And while we can’t bring every talented person into our team, we can help them land somewhere that’s just as mission-driven. That’s why we’re sharing opportunities from MOPO; a company we’ve proudly backed through a strategic investment.

MOPO is on a mission to enable renewable energy access in underserved markets. Already operating in Nigeria, DRC, Sierra Leone and Liberia, our solar power stations distribute energy through proprietary MOPO batteries managed by a network of local agents. Our model is already powering thousands of homes and small businesses, reducing reliance on fossil fuels and enabling livelihoods. With backing from Octopus Energy, British International Investment, and Norfund, MOPO is scaling rapidly and is positioned to transform energy access and e-mobility across the continent.

Joining our growing team, you’ll provide hands-on technical leadership and people management for the software team behind MOPO’s core software products: our Android Rental App and the MOPO Platform, a web application built with Django, Python and Vue.js. Together, these tools enable our network of local agents to manage battery distribution and customer relationships across our markets.

title: Applied AI Engineer (all genders)

Pivotal Research finds people who can work on the biggest risks facing humanity and gets them working on them.

We have grown from 2 staff in 2024 to 10 today, and our programmes have more than doubled in size every year. We had 75 participants in 2026. In 2027 we plan to have at least 180 participants across five cohorts of our AI safety and biodefense fellowships, start at least two new programmes, and grow to at least 16 staff.

We are hiring a COO to make sure Pivotal runs well now, still runs well at three times the size, and still runs well when we scale beyond that. You will be responsible for the team that supports execution of our programmes, finances, our systems & processes, and the London office. You will start by managing at least 2 people and build the team from there.

You will be the second most senior person at Pivotal and work directly with Tobias Häberli, our CEO, who will focus on strategy, fundraising and new programmes.

Why this role matters

We think the next few years are unusually important. AGI could bring enormous benefits, and could also cause existential catastrophes. Reducing those risks depends on getting capable people working on the right problems early enough.

Since 2024, 135 fellows have participated in our programmes. Alumni have gone on to roles at METR, Apollo Research, UK AISI, and GovAI, as well as AI Safety fellowships and internships at Anthropic and OpenAI. We measure our success by the important work our fellows go on to do, and how much Pivotal helped them get there.

PLC and machine side

  • Decide and implement how data leaves the PLC: MQTT publishing from the PLC itself, or a read on the edge device (S7 protocol or OPC UA) that publishes on its behalf. Pick one, justify it, standardise it.

Our customers include Fortune 500 enterprises and global industry leaders, including Anduril, Canva, Fortinet, Hewlett Packard Enterprise, OpenAI, Snap Inc., and Snowflake.

Chainguard is venture-backed by leading investors, including Amplify, IVP, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Mantis VC, Redpoint Ventures, Sequoia Capital, and Spark Capital.

The role, in a nutshell:

Chainguard is building a safer foundation for software. We work with security and engineering teams who care deeply about supply chain security, open source, and modern infrastructure. We’re looking for a BDR who already knows how to run outbound, and is ready to take it further into more technical conversations, more complex organizations, and more strategic account development.

This role is about earning attention from engineers and security leaders, not just landing meetings. You’ll partner closely with enterprise AEs to break into high-value accounts and build pipeline that actually converts.

What you’ll do:

  • Drive enterprise account strategy - Work alongside AEs to map target accounts and identify the right entry points across security, platform, and engineering teams.
  • Run thoughtful, technical outbound - Craft highly personalized outreach that resonates with developers, DevOps, and security leaders — no generic sequences.
  • Understand how modern infrastructure works - Research how companies build and ship software (containers, CI/CD, cloud environments) to make your outreach relevant and credible.
  • Lead meaningful early conversations - Qualify opportunities by understanding technical context, risk posture, and business priorities.
  • Build real pipeline, not just meetings - Focus on creating opportunities that move forward — quality over quantity.
  • Act as an extension of the AE - Collaborate on account plans, messaging, and deal progression.
  • Use tools intelligently - Leverage Salesforce, Outreach/Salesloft, and data tools to execute efficiently — but never at the expense of quality.
  • Continuously improve the motion - Test messaging, share insights, and help refine how we engage the market.
  • Be a feedback loop to the business - Bring insights from conversations back to marketing and product — especially what resonates (or doesn’t) with technical buyers.

What we're looking for:

title: Engagement Manager - Insights & Data
description: Engagement Manager – Insights & Data   Bli med og skap verdi gjennom data, analyse og AI   I Capgemini hjelper vi virksomheter med å realisere verdien av data, analyse og kunstig intelligens. Gjennom kombinasjonen av sterk forretningsforståelse, moderne teknologi og dyktige fagmiljøer bidrar vi til å løse komplekse utfordringer for noen av landets største virksomheter.  Vårt Insights & Data-miljø består av rådgivere, arkitekter, utviklere, data engineers, prosjektledere og fageksperter som jobber tett sammen for å levere løsninger som skaper reell forretningsverdi.  Nå ser vi etter en erfaren Engagement Manager som ønsker å ta ansvar for kundeengasjementer fra oppstart til vellykket leveranse.   Om rollen   Som Engagement Manager får du en sentral rolle i skjæringspunktet mellom kunde, teknologi og leveranse. Du har det overordnede ansvaret for at kundeengasjementer leveres med høy kvalitet, god økonomisk kontroll og høy kundetilfredshet.  Du vil samarbeide tett med kunder, leveranseteam og Capgeminis fagmiljøer, samtidig som du bidrar til å videreutvikle hvordan vi leverer prosjekter innen data, analyse, AI og moderne dataplattformer.  Aktuelle arbeidssteder er Oslo, Bergen, Stavanger, Trondheim, Kristiansand og Fredrikstad.  Hva vil du jobbe med?  Du vil lede leveranser innen blant annet data, analyse, AI og moderne dataplattformer. Oppdragene varierer i størrelse, kompleksitet og kommersiell modell.   Ansvarsområdene Inkluderer Blant Annet     Lede og koordinere kundeengasjementer, prosjekter, programmer og tjenesteleveranser. Sikre fremdrift, kvalitet og leveranseevne gjennom hele prosjektets livssyklus  Bygge sterke relasjoner med kunder og sentrale interessenter. Etablere tydelig styring, roller, ansvar og beslutningsprosesser  Håndtere risiko, avhengigheter og endringer på en strukturert måte. Følge opp økonomi, ressursstyring og leveranseplaner  Samarbeide tett med arkitekter, tekniske spesialister og fagressurser. Delta i tilbudsprosesser, estimering og mobilisering av nye kundeoppdrag. Identifisere videre muligheter hos eksisterende kunder. Bidra til utviklingen av leveransemetodikk og beste praksis i Insights & Data.    Hvem ser vi etter?  Vi ser etter deg som trives med å lede komplekse leveranser og motiveres av å skape resultater gjennom mennesker, teknologi og samarbeid.  Du trenger ikke være den sterkeste tekniske eksperten i rommet, men du må ha forståelse for hvordan teknologi og forretningsmål henger sammen.   Vi Tror Du Har     Erfaring med prosjektledelse, programledelse, delivery management eller engagement management  Erfaring med kunde- og interessenthåndtering. God forståelse for prosjektøkonomi og kommersielle leveransemodeller  Erfaring med kontrakter, endringshåndtering og risikostyring. Erfaring fra leveranser innen data, analyse, AI eller dataplattformer  Erfaring med tilbudsprosesser, estimering eller oppstart av nye leveranser. Evne til å skape tillit, struktur og retning i komplekse leveran

-Drive marketplace and listing strategy across hyper-scaler marketplaces along with integration marketplaces such as the Okta Integration Network.

Help turn Checkly's incident response, on-call and status pages from a young product that customers already pay for into a core part of our platform. In 2027 agents will be on call and we want to be ready for that. You'll shape what we build in 2027, build it with AI coding agents, and talk directly to the teams who use it in the middle of an incident.

The best engineering teams don't wait for users to tell them something's broken. They build resilient, reliable systems to catch it first: in the pull request, in staging, or production at 3am, before a single customer notices. That instinct is Checkly's whole reason to exist.

Checkly gives developers, SRE teams and their agents the tools to own reliability the way they own their code: testing and synthetic monitoring defined as code, built on OpenTelemetry and Playwright. From pull request to post-mortem, in one place.

This role is about the post-mortem end of that line. We've built incident management, status pages and on-call into Checkly, and it's already bringing in revenue. Now we want to drive it strategically. Figure out together with us how to evolve incident management with clear signals and with agents being on call.

title: Automation Engineer - Facilities SCADA & PLC (f/m/d)
description:
The Role

We are looking for an experienced Automation Engineer to take technical ownership of the Facilities Monitoring and Control System (FMCS) that keeps our fab running - the system that supervises every utility our production depends on, from cleanroom air and chilled water to process cooling, exhaust and power monitoring. The system is delivered and commissioned by an external integrator; from handover, it's yours. You won't be building it from scratch - you'll be the person who understands it well enough to keep it running, diagnose it when it misbehaves, extend it as we grow from pilot line to full production, and hold suppliers to account. If the FMCS has an issue at 03:00, you're the one who knows what to do.

To join our team, you should be excited to:

  • Operate, monitor and maintain our SCADA system (Siemens WinCC OA or Yokogawa DCS Centum) across servers, operator stations and displays

  • Maintain and diagnose our Siemens S7-1500 PLCs and their remote I/O, and adapt control logic within the existing standardised structure

  • Plan and perform loop checks end to end - tracing each signal from the field device through wiring, I/O and PLC all the way to the operator screen, and confirming that commands actually move valves, dampers and actuators

  • Investigate and resolve alarms, communication faults and unexpected equipment behaviourduring live operation

  • Verify instrument calibration and troubleshoot analog and digital field signals - multimeter in hand, not only from a screen

description:

We are looking for a Senior Embedded Systems Engineer to develop the board management infrastructure for Openchip's next-generation data center accelerator platforms.

In this role, you will own the complete board management solution from hardware definition and MCU integration through firmware development, bring-up, validation, and deployment. · Define and implement board management architectures for validation platforms, debug boards, and accelerator cards.

· Develop firmware and software for power sequencing, telemetry, monitoring, voltage margining, reset control, and platform automation.

· Evaluate, customize, and integrate technologies such as OpenBMC and other open-source management frameworks.

· Enable remote platform access, recovery, and management capabilities for engineering teams.

· Collaborate with hardware teams on schematic reviews, hardware integration, and bring-up requirements.

· Create tools, scripts, and automation to improve validation efficiency and engineering productivity.

· Support first-silicon bring-up, board debugging, and platform validation activities.

· Debug hardware and firmware interactions using oscilloscopes, logic

title: Control & Estimation Intern
description:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

We are developing the flight control systems of our next-generation autonomous platforms, which are embedded and subjected to extreme operational constraints. As with any aeronautical system, no model is perfect: aerodynamic effects, actuator dynamics, wind, payload changes, damage or degraded sensors are never fully captured by the physics-based models we rely on.

These unmodelled dynamics are one of the main sources of performance loss and risk for a controller, especially at the edge of the flight envelope. To push the boundaries of control, we are working on estimating these disturbances online and compensating for them in real time through adaptive control and robust estimation.

Your mission

The goal of this internship is to design, implement and validate a framework for estimating and compensating unmodelled physics disturbances, in order to improve the robustness and performance of our flight controller in extreme and uncertain conditions.

  • Develop Python-based deployment tooling to provision targets with a reproducible OS + SDK environment (image delivery, flashing, and environment setup).
  • Debug at the OS boundary - init/service failures, library and ABI mismatches, missing dependencies, and SDK/runtime issues on the target.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
Our mission is to enable everyone to build wealth

We reinvent how trading and investing work by creating exceptional products people love. Fostering a culture of excellence and high velocity is the key to our success. Тoday, we serve over 6 million clients, with more than €38 billion in assets under management — a testament to the scale and trust we’ve built in just a few years.

The role

You'll own a product area end to end, including its legal and regulatory position. We're hiring across trading and execution (order routing, settlement, corporate actions), tax-efficient investing and pensions (ISAs, SIPPs and German pension accounts), crypto, and client accounts and payments (onboarding, client money, cards and FX). You work directly with your engineers, designers, Legal, Compliance, and Operations, and answer for both the client experience and the commercial result.

What you'll do

  • Decide what your area builds next, from client needs, product data and commercial goals, and defend the choice

  • Read the regulation, the API documentation and the operational process yourself, and form the position before Legal and Compliance review it

  • Write the spec: client journey, business rules, data, integrations and acceptance criteria, detailed enough to build and test from

  • Carry your decisions through delivery with Engineering, Design, Legal, Compliance and Operations

  • Take the product through testing and launch, then run it: monitoring, client feedback, the numbers, the next improvement

What you need to have

title: Treasury Manager (Liquidity)
description:
Our mission is to enable everyone to build wealth.

We reinvent how trading and investing work by creating exceptional products people love. Fostering a culture of excellence and high velocity is the key to our success.

Role Overview

We’re looking for a highly analytical, data-driven Treasury Manager to strengthen our liquidity management and treasury risk framework, working closely with Trading, Finance, Risk, Product and executive stakeholders.

What you’ll do

  • Build liquidity forecasts, stress tests and treasury risk models to inform funding, liquidity buffers and contingency planning, with clear documentation for second-line challenge.

  • Support day-to-day funding across group entities, including FX dealing, cash positioning and liquidity management.

  • Contribute liquidity analysis to ICARA, wind-down planning and other relevant risk assessments.

  • Own Treasury Risk and Control Self-Assessments (RCSAs), assess controls and drive remediation.

  • Write and maintain clear treasury policies and procedures.

  • Improve modelling, dashboards and reporting using Excel, SQL, Power BI, and AI tools.

  • Assess the liquidity and treasury risks of new products and business initiatives, presenting recommendations and escalating emerging risks.

What you need to have

title: General Ledger (GL) Accountant
description:
Who are we?

Smarkets: Predicting the Future of Betting

Smarkets runs one of the world's most sophisticated prediction markets, handling over £29 billion in volume since 2010 and engaging 200,000+ traders globally. We're a technology company that happens to revolutionise betting — from sports to political markets, delivering the sharpest prices and the fairest odds.

We're also growing: we're pursuing licensing with the CFTC to expand into the US market, a significant step in our ambition to become a truly global exchange. Joining now means being part of that next chapter, not just maintaining what's already built.

At the heart of our success are our people. We create a high-performance environment where exceptional talent can thrive, blending deep business experience with a commercial mindset to drive strategic growth.

The Team

Finance makes sure Smarkets has accurate, timely numbers to run the business, satisfy regulators, and stand up to investor scrutiny — across multiple jurisdictions and licences. Two things keep us busy:

  • Reporting & Control — close, statutory accounts, audit, and the controls framework behind a dual UKGC/CFTC regulated business

  • Systems & Transformation — building out reporting on top of our ERP and automating away the manual stuff

A typical week: run a clean close and turn it into a board-ready pack, write a technical paper on a tricky accounting area, ship an automated process and make it audit-ready.

title: Sales Operations Lead
description:
About Watershed

Watershed is the enterprise sustainability platform. Companies like Airbnb, Carlyle Group, FedEx, Visa, and Dr. Martens use Watershed to manage climate and ESG data, produce audit-ready metrics for voluntary and regulatory reporting including CSRD, and drive real decarbonization. We are looking for team members who love product-building, want to work hard at a mission-oriented startup, and will collaborate with us in shaping the culture of a growing team.

We have offices in San Francisco, New York, Denver, London, Paris, Berlin, Sydney, Mexico City, and remote team members across the US and Europe. We hope that you'll be interested in joining us!

The role

Watershed is on a mission to help companies measure, reduce, and report their emissions. Our go-to-market organization continues to grow, with an emphasis on scale and deepening our presence in EMEA. We're looking for a hands-on operator to run sales operations for the region and build the tools & processes our sellers rely on.

You'll partner closely with EMEA sales leadership to drive the day-to-day operating rhythm of the team - forecasting, pipeline reviews, and planning - and dig into the data to identify risks and opportunities for growth.

This is a role for an operator who builds what they design and has already rewired their work around AI. Alongside the operating rhythm, your project work will be building AI agents, tools, and workflows that help our AEs, SDRs, and Solutions teams move our revenue metrics.

This position is based in our London office

ExTrac is a decision intelligence company used by governments, defence organisations, financial institutions, and corporates operating in complex, fast-moving environments. Our capabilities fuse curated data sources, domain-specific AI, and deep human expertise to transform information overload into clear, actionable foresight.

Our ambition is to become the analytical backbone that organisations rely on when geopolitical uncertainty becomes an opportunity or a strategic risk. More at extrac.ai.

We are looking for a Head of Business Development, Defence to lead the next phase of ExTrac's growth across UK and European defence. This is a senior, high-impact role for someone who combines deep familiarity with defence and national security with the energy and agility of the technology sector.

You will set the direction for ExTrac's defence business: deciding which customers, programmes and markets we pursue, building the pipeline and partnerships to win them, and growing the team that delivers it. Reporting to the Director of Growth, you will be the senior commercial face of ExTrac to defence customers, and the voice of the defence customer inside ExTrac.

Defence growth strategy

  • Shape and execute ExTrac's growth strategy across UK and European defence.

  • Set the defence go-to-market plan: priority customers, programmes and markets, revenue targets, and where ExTrac will deliberately not play.

  • Own the defence revenue target and forecast, reporting progress

description:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. About us

Foundational is building the most precise picture of Earth and orbit, using lasers fired from the ground. We call it ground truth for orbit.

Our data platform turns those measurements into tracking data and orbit products for satellite operators, space agencies and governments. description:
About Prelude

Prelude is redefining how companies authenticate and onboard users - turning what's traditionally a cost center into a growth lever.

Our flagship product lets businesses send OTP codes with the best price-to-conversion ratio on the market, dynamically selecting the most effective channel in real time (optimized SMS, WhatsApp, and more) while actively blocking spam and fraud that legacy providers miss.

Founded in 2022 by former Zenly team members who lived the pain of broken SMS authentication firsthand, we're already serving fast-growing companies across Europe and are expanding into the US.

But authentication is only the starting point - we're building the platform for trust at scale, with an ambitious roadmap of market-defining products ahead.

Why join us

Today, we're a team of 60 and growing, based in Paris, building products that power secure and high-performance user onboarding for companies across the world. We believe small, highly skilled teams outperform large, fragmented organizations, and we are intentional about staying focused on impact, quality, and speed.

We operate with a flat org structure and value in-person collaboration, which helps ideas move faster, decisions stay grounded, and teams take full ownership of what they build.

About Fractile

Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts.

 

The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. The defining work of the 21st century will be marked by the engine of inference delivering immense and diffuse chains of intellectual inquiry, in drug discovery, in software engineering, in materials discovery, in any field where progress is driven by deep reasoning and intelligence to resolve complex problems.

You will lead Fractile’s Post-Silicon Validation team, taking first silicon from power-on to a fully characterised, working product. The team sits within the Architecture group and owns functional validation (bring-up) and characterisation of new silicon as it returns from manufacture, enabling the system-level product bring-up. You will build validation and characterisation content under simulation ahead of first silicon, deploy and debug it on the real devices, and drive the test infrastructure and methodology the whole programme depends on.

About Fractile

Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts.

 

The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. The defining work of the 21st century will be marked by the engine of inference delivering immense and diffuse chains of intellectual inquiry, in drug discovery, in software engineering, in materials discovery, in any field where progress is driven by deep reasoning and intelligence to resolve complex problems.

The role

Fractile designs chips and systems that are manufactured, tested and assembled by a global network of subcontractors. The Director of Data Analytics owns how that data reaches Fractile and how it is handled, stored and processed so the business can turn it into actionable intel.

You will set up the data pipes to our subcontractors, build full chip-to-system genealogy to provide full system traceability and integrate cleansed supplier data into the Fractile ERP system. The result is the data framework behind real-time product WIP reports, raw material inventory levels and product cost variance reporting.</

As a Member of Technical Staff on our safety research team, you'll research and ship methods that make FLUX models safe by design: from what goes into the training data to how the models are mid- and post-trained, across images, video and the text that conditions them. This is a role with real ownership: you won't just do research on model safety, you'll shape it. The methods you build ship in FLUX models with over 75 million downloads on Hugging Face and in production at some of the largest platforms in the world.

Cameras on 20+ production lines stream video into our models, which turn every step (assembling, screwing, inspecting) into structured data several times per second. description:
Your mission

About SIDES

Restaurants are where people come together over good food. We build the technology that keeps them running.

SIDES is the operating system for hospitality: POS, payments, delivery, kitchen tools, self-order terminals, apps and webshops on one platform. Thousands of restaurants run on it and millions of transactions flow through it every month, peaking on a Friday night when nothing is allowed to fail.

We have the owner's and the chef's back, so they can focus on their food and their guests. And it is not just code on a screen: our software runs on real hardware in real restaurants, from POS devices to self-order terminals and more.

We love AI. We see it as a way to spend less time on boilerplate and more on what matters: good architecture, sound decisions and software that holds up on a busy Friday night. Nobody has figured all of this out yet. We experiment, share what works, drop what doesn't, and keep raising the bar together.

title: Head of Content Marketing (m/w/d) – B2B Personal Branding
description:
Du baust Founder-Brands, die Deals schließen?

Dann baue zwei B2B-Founder-Brands von 0 auf, steuere LinkedIn & Funnel und werde direkt am erzeugten Umsatz beteiligt.

Das ist eine Senior-Rolle mit voller Verantwortung, direkt an der Seite der beiden Gründer.

Vor 5,5 Jahren saßen wir zu zweit in einer WG in Düsseldorf. Kein Büro, kein Umsatz, keine Kunden. Nur ein Telefon.

Heute sind wir 35 Leute auf knapp 900 m² Office. Rügamer & Steiner ist eine E-Mail- und CRM-Marketing-Agentur für E-Commerce: Wir helfen Onlineshops, mehr Umsatz aus ihren Bestandskunden zu holen – mit E-Mail-Marketing, WhatsApp, Printmailings und datengetriebenem CRM. Für über 150 Shops steuern wir so über 200 Mio. € Jahresumsatz mit. Unser eigener Umsatz liegt im mittleren einstelligen Millionenbereich und hat sich seit der Gründung jedes Jahr verdoppelt.

Alles davon ist aus Telefonaten entstanden. Kein Marketing, keine Brand, kein Content. Erst haben wir selbst telefoniert, heute tut es ein 6-köpfiges Sales-Team, das gerade auf 10 wächst.

Unser Haken: Uns kennt kein Mensch.

Das ändern wir jetzt. Bis 2028 wollen wir 30 Mio. € Jahresumsatz machen und europäischer Marktführer werden in dem, was wir tun. Für unsere Kunden wollen wir jedes Jahr über 1 Mrd. € Umsatz bewegen. Dafür brauchen wir Sichtbarkeit. Und dafür brauchen wir dich.

Das Material liegt bereit: eine echte Geschichte, Zahlen, Cases und zwei Gründer, die jedes Jahr über 300.000 € investieren, um von den Besten zu lernen – unter anderem in der höchsten Mastermind von Alex Hormozi.

Deine Mission

  • Du baust die Personal Brands von Noah Rügamer und Aurelian Steiner auf – zuerst auf LinkedIn, später Newsletter, YouTube und Podcast.

  • Du entwickelst Positionierung, Content-Strategie, Formate, Hooks und Redaktionsplan – mit Fokus auf E-Commerce-Unternehmer, die mehr aus ihren Bestandskunden holen wollen.

title: Testeur QA / Recette fonctionnelle (H/F) – Mission à mi-temps - FREELANCE
description:
ImaginePartners recherche, pour l’un de ses clients, un testeur QA fonctionnel (H/F) pour une mission de 6 mois à mi-temps. Vous interviendrez sur plusieurs projets d’évolution du système d’information, dans un environnement principalement Microsoft. Votre rôle sera de valider les applications avant leur mise en production, de la préparation des tests à la vérification des corrections.

Modalités de la mission

  • Démarrage — Dès que possible

  • Durée — 6 mois

  • Rythme — Mi-temps, avec une répartition des jours à convenir

  • Localisation — Région de Marseille, avec possibilité de travailler à distance

  • TJM — À proposer

  • Analyser les besoins métiers et les spécifications, identifier les parcours à tester et définir la stratégie de test de chaque projet.

  • Qualifier et documenter les anomalies, suivre leur correction avec les développeurs et effectuer les contre-tests.

  • Prioriser les campagnes entre les projets, communiquer les résultats aux équipes métiers et techniques et contribuer à harmoniser les pratiques de test.

Profil recherché

Vous avez une expérience significative en tests logiciels ou en recette fonctionnelle d’applications web ou de systèmes d’information d’entreprise. Vous savez mener une campagne de test en autonomie, documenter vos résultats et gérer plusieurs sujets en parallèle. Vous avez utilisé Azure DevOps, Jira ou un outil éq

title: Outbound Account Development Representative - France
description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the Role

As an Account Development Representative (ADR) at Samsara, you will be trained, both on the job and with formal training programs led by a world-class team of sales professionals, to take on your next role as closing Account Executive. 

On a daily basis, you will be responsible for sourcing pipelines for our EMEA business,  generating opportunities via outbound outreach. 

We have offices in Munich, Paris and Amsterdam and we offer remote working from Germany, France, The Netherlands and London. Our European headquarters are based in London.

This is a remote position open

description:
gravity9 is recruiting Java engineers and architects for a portfolio of engagements across UK central government. These are large-scale, data-intensive modernisation programmes: replacing legacy systems that carry statutory weight, decomposing monoliths that serve millions of users, and building secure data platforms where access control and auditability are first-class architectural concerns rather than late additions.

We are hiring across two overlapping profiles — Senior Java Developer and Application / Migration Architect — and expect most people to move between programmes as engagements start and complete. Several of these are hands-on architect roles: you will own design decisions and also write production code

The kind of work

The following are representative of current and upcoming engagements. Individual roles will draw on some of this, not all of it — we are more interested in engineers who can work confidently at the intersection of Java and data than in a checklist match against any one programme.

Secure data catalogue and access-control platform

A greenfield metadata catalogue acting as a federated index over data held across independent domains, so that authorised parties can locate and retrieve data the catalogue itself never holds. The work includes designing an attribute-based access control model over attributes such as clearance, nationality, organisational unit and compartment; enforcing those policies inside the database query path rather than filtering results afterwards; application-layer encryption with externally managed keys; hybrid lexical and semantic search with access filtering applied before candidate retrieval rather than after it; and a tamper-evident audit trail that can reconstruct why a given record was returned, redacted or withheld.

Real-time decision-support data architecture

title: Thermo-Mechanical Engineer
description:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecraft for humanity.

The heart of a spacecraft lies in its engines, and that's why we, at The Exploration Company, are dedicated to developing our own cutting-edge Propulsion Systems ensuring the highest level of efficiency and reliability in our space endeavours.

 

We are seeking a talented Thermo-Mechanical Engineer to join our Future Project division. As a key member of our engineering team, you will be responsible for designing, analyzing, and optimizing combustion devices for cryogenic rocket engines, with a focus on the main thrust chamber assembly.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Support structural and thermal analysis of combustion device hardware including injector heads, faceplates, combustion chambers, manifolds, and structural interfaces.

  • Perform finite element analysis (FEA) and establish practical design suggestions and establish design recommendations, and margin assessments for hardware development.

  • Develop and apply analytical and reduced-order models to estimate heat transfer, structural loads, and thermal boundary conditions to inform design trades and hardware maturation.

  • Support hardware development and maturation, including design iteration, development planning, test definition, and post-test assessment of structural and thermal performance.

  • Drive life assessment activities, including low-cycle fatigue, thermal fatigue, cyclic loading, margin tracking, and damage accumulation for reusable hardware.

title: AI Associate - m/f/d
description:
Help Us Change the Way the World Works

Build something that matters.

Langdock exists to change the way the world works, bridging the gap between what technology can do and what people actually do with it. We bring all leading AI models into one secure, model-agnostic platform and make them usable across entire organizations. Over 10,000 companies use our platform every day, from fast-growing startups to some of Europe's largest enterprises. Their employees open Langdock to draft strategies, analyze documents, or automate workflows - helping them to work smarter, think more creatively, and reach their full potential.

About the Role

This is a full-time, 12-month program at our Berlin HQ for people who want to understand AI rather than just use it.

It begins where our product meets the real world: customer support. Many support tickets are a small puzzle about how large language models and cloud software behave in production. Why did the same prompt give two different answers? Why did a long document get cut off? Why is one model fast today and slow tomorrow? Why did an agent call the wrong tool? Why did an API integration time out? You will be the person who works out what is actually going on and explains it clearly.

For most of your first year, the support queue is your home base and your classroom. Few jobs expose you to as many real AI systems, real enterprise environments, and real failure modes, every single day.

The purpose of the year: by month twelve, you should understand our platform and operations deeply, from the chat interface down to the models and infrastructure behind it. A Langdock business team should want to hire you permanently, and you should have found the work that energizes you most

about us

Every 10 minutes, 18 million conversations happen between businesses and consumers around the world.

For decades, the consumer side of those conversations sucked: long queues, robotic menus, repeated explanations, and advice that is often unhelpful. Most people today still cannot simply say what their problem is in natural language when communicating with businesses.

AI changes that. For the first time, companies can have natural conversations with customers at massive scale. Every B2C company - from energy providers to telcos to insurers - will use AI agents to talk to their customers. The number of conversations businesses will handle is going to explode in the coming years.

At telli, we are solving the challenges that come with that shift. Today, leading B2C companies like Sky are already using telli to deploy thousands of voice agents to provide their customers with a new experience. But building a first voice agent is easy, getting it to drive real outcomes for customers and businesses is the hard part. telli helps companies build, deploy, and improve consumer-facing AI voice agents at scale. This will become one of the most important software categories of the next decade, and we intend to win it.

Our latest proprietary foundation models power our products and the custom models we build with partners.

  • Boltz Lab and the Boltz API. Our products run our latest models, design pipelines (BoltzMol for small molecules, BoltzProt for protein design) and agents as reliable, production-grade tools built around real chemistry and biology workflows. Teams start from a target and a hypothesis, then generate, evaluate, and rank candidate molecules in Boltz Lab, run our models from their own code and agents through the Boltz API, or deploy them inside their own environment.

The two feed each other: our open releases earn scientific credibility and community insight, and our products turn our full range of models into real impact for partners including Pfizer, Takeda, GSK, Bristol Myers Squibb and DSM-Firmenich.

title: Software Engineer, Robot Autonomy (Planning & Navigation)
description:
Our Mission

At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient.

We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today!

The Role

As a Software Engineer on Robot Autonomy, you will make our robots navigate dependably across real customer sites. Our stack works. The gap between working and dependable is the whole job. Every new site tests how a robot understands its surroundings and chooses where to go: a ramp the planner avoids, a narrow passage that exposes a poor route, a gate that changes the map, a person who steps into the robot's path, or localization drift that builds over a long patrol. You treat those cases as the real navigation problem to solve, not as edge cases.

You'll shape the technical choices behind reliable navigation, from sensor selection, ground segmentation, and traversability estimation to predicting how people and vehicles move and planning safe, efficient routes around them. The system has to work day and night, in challenging weather, across different embodiments and changing site conditions. We measure success by whether the robot completes its patrol on a live site, not by how it performs in simulation.

What You'll Work On

Legal AI is zo goed als de kennis erachter. Bij Lefebvre Sdu bouwen we al 200 jaar aan die kennis. Dag in, dag uit. Wet voor wet. Woord voor woord. Andere legal AI-tools draaien op onze data en software. Als Nederlands hart van Lefebvre Group, de Europese leider in juridische en fiscale kennis, ontwikkelen we bovendien ons eigen platform: GenIA-L, waarop juristen en fiscalisten niet zomaar een antwoord krijgen, maar een antwoord waar ze hun naam onder durven te zetten. Meer dan 75.000 professionals werken er dagelijks mee, goed voor ruim 100 miljoen euro ARR in Europa. We zoeken een Senior HR Business Partner die ons team door een verandertraject begeleidt en adviseert.

HOE JIJ ONS VERDER BRENGT

Lefebvre Sdu transformeert van uitgever naar techbedrijf. Nergens is dat zo voelbaar als in ons product team. De mensen die hier werken bouwen het platform waarop onze AI-revolutie draait, en ze doen dat terwijl de organisatie om hen heen verandert. 70 mensen nu, vacatures open, en een opdracht die elke maand groter wordt. Jij bent de HR Adviseur die dit team begeleidt. Niet op afstand, maar als iemand die begrijpt wat er speelt, de juiste vragen stelt en mensen vooruit helpt. Dit ga je doen:

  • Jij bent de HR-partner van het team dat onze transformatie mogelijk maakt. Wat hier speelt is direct voelbaar in de hele organisatie.

  • Je begeleidt managers en medewerkers in het content, tech- en IT-team op alle HR vraagstukken, van instroom tot ontwikkeling.

  • Je signaleert wat er speelt in het team en vertaalt dat naar concrete HR-interventies die werken.

  • Je adviseert managers bij veelvoorkomende thema’s rondom leiderschap, performance en talent development.

  • Je draagt actief bij aan de cultuurverandering die bij deze transformatie hoort.

title: Cloud Architect
description:
About Vitestro

Founded in 2017 in Utrecht, Vitestro is pioneering the future of blood collection with the Aletta® Autonomous Robotic Phlebotomy Device™ (ARPD™). This groundbreaking medical device combines advanced multi-modal imaging (near-infrared, ultrasound, and Doppler ultrasound) with robotics and AI to perform the entire diagnostic blood draw procedure autonomously.

 

By addressing critical healthcare staffing shortages and improving patient experience, Vitestro is transforming one of the most common and essential medical procedures. With more than 130 team members and growing rapidly, we are scaling our impact. As we placed our first devices with customers, we are now expanding our team to ensure successful implementation and long-term reliability.

 

At Vitestro, we are committed to continuous innovation and improvement.

We are looking for a Cloud Architect to shape and implement Vitestro's cloud platform with a clear, pragmatic technical direction. Our infrastructure runs on AWS and supports mission-critical, regulated medical device software. Vitestro is also realizing its first integration with Laboratory Information System (LIS) over the cloud, and delivering that connection is a core part of this role. We need someone who translates real operational and business constraints into working systems — someone whose first instinct is "what does this actually need to do, reliably and affordably," not "what's the most sophisticated way to solve this."

title: System Engineer Network (m/w/d)
description:
Auf den KRITIS-Sektor spezialisiert, garantieren wir den digitalen Erfolg unserer Kunden unter höchsten Sicherheits- und Qualitätsstandards. Wer bei EWERK arbeitet, gestaltet aktiv an der digitalen Transformation von Wirtschaft, Politik und Gesellschaft mit und muss trotz der hohen Relevanz des eigenen Schaffens nicht auf eine lockere, moderne und innovative Arbeitsatmosphäre verzichten. Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir ab sofort eine:n System Engineer (m/w/d) Network.

Deine Mission

  • Planung, Implementierung und Weiterentwicklung moderner Netzwerk- und Security-InfrastrukturenFire
  • Betrieb, Wartung und Optimierung komplexer LAN-, WAN- und Firewall-Umgebungen
  • Analyse und Behebung von Störungen sowie Performance- und Sicherheitsproblemen
  • Automatisierung wiederkehrender Aufgaben und Prozesse
  • Beratung interner Projekt- und Fachteams bei Netzwerk- und Security-Themen

  • Erfahrung mit Monitoring- und Troubleshooting-Tools wie Wireshark, CheckMK oder PRTG
  • Linux-Kenntnisse im administrativen Umfeld
  • Idealerweise Erfahrung mit Netzwerkautomatisierung (z. B. Ansible oder Terraform)
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- sowie gute Englischkenntnisse

Vollständige Stellenbeschreibung

Mit „Meine Landausflüge“ (meine-landausfluege.de) setzen wir als führende Buchungsplattform für individuelle Ausflugserlebnisse neue Maßstäbe in der Kreuzfahrtbranche. Durch kleine Gruppengrößen und persönliche, familiäre Ausflüge ermöglichen wir Kreuzfahrtgästen individuellere und intensivere Erlebnisse in den Destinationen. Vom Herzen Hamburgs aus treibt unser engagiertes Team die Branche mit frischen Ideen voran. Wir setzen auf eine sorgfältige Auswahl lokaler Anbieter weltweit und arbeiten mit renommierten touristischen Vertriebspartnern aus DACH zusammen, um unseren Kunden nicht nur ihre Wünsche zu erfüllen, sondern sie zu begeistern.

Zum Februar/März 2027 suchen wir in Hamburg Praktikanten (m/w/d) zur tatkräftigen Unterstützung im Bereich Customer Service/ Operations. Die Mindestdauer des Praktikums beträgt 3 Monate (gerne auch im Rahmen eines Praxissemesters während deines Studiums).

Das gibt es bei uns zu tun:

  • Beratung unserer Kunden: Beantwortung und Bearbeitung von Anfragen und Buchungen per E-Mail und Telefon

  • Korrespondenz per E-Mail und Telefon mit unseren lokalen Agenturen auf Deutsch und Englisch

  • Erstellung, Prüfung und Versendung von Kundenunterlagen

  • Nutzung von Outlook, Microsoft Office sowie dem betriebseigenen Buchungssystem

Wir freuen uns auf folgende Qualifikationen und Kompetenzen von dir:

  • Bildung und Sprachkenntnisse: Fortgeschrittenes Studium bevorzugt mit Schwerpunkt Tourismus oder Ähnlichem und sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

  • Begeisterung für Kommunikation: Freude an der Kundenkommunikation sowie eine gute Ausdrucksweise

  • Arbeitsstil: Du organisierst deine Aufgaben gut, arbeitest sorgfältig und eigenständig

description:

Manufacturing runs on fragmented data: machines, sensors and decade-old systems that don't talk to each other. Data sits in departmental silos, knowledge lives in people's heads, and AI can't unfold its potential in point solutions that don't deliver. At Manex AI, we build the missing layer. Our platform handles manufacturing data at scale, models the factory ontology and builds agentic applications that reason and act across it.

We're a fast-growing team in Munich, backed by Lightspeed and BlueYard, with engineers from top companies and leading enterprise manufacturers as customers. We ship fast, work close to the shopfloor, and we don't ship things we're not proud of.

The Role

As Product Engineer with a frontend focus, you'll build the product features our customers use every day, fully owning the product with a strong focus on usability and intuitive design. You'll use AI to ship a high volume of polished work and stay close to the problems of the people who use it. You'll work directly with founders, engineers and customers, and see your work in production at leading manufacturers.

What You'll Do

  • Product features: Take features from first idea to production

  • Customer applications: Turn manufacturing use cases into interfaces that users pick up without training

  • Architecture: Make the calls that keep our frontend consistent, maintainable and ready to scale

  • Design & usability: Shape flows, layouts, interactions and UI patterns so that users understand them without explanation

  • Customer feedback: Talk to users, observe how they work and turn what you learn in

title: Senior Software Engineer - Go SDK - Language Clients

The Integrations Ecosystem org builds the drivers, SDKs, connectors and BI integrations that make ClickHouse feel native in any stack. The Language Clients team maintains the official clients for Python, JavaScript, Java, Go, Rust, C++ and C#, plus the ODBC, JDBC and ADBC drivers. We're small, senior and remote across North America and EMEA.

The role

We're looking for a product-minded engineer to own ClickHouse's Go clients. You'll decide what the clients should do by talking to the developers who use them, reading the issues and the telemetry, and listening to the community. title: Research Working Student, Microbiology
description:
Role summary:

At Differential Bio, we combine data, AI, and lab automation to optimize media and bioprocesses - building the intelligence engine for the bioeconomy’s future. We turn wet-lab experiments into model-ready datasets that train our machine-learning models, making microbial production faster, cheaper, and more predictable for customers in probiotics, food, and specialty chemicals.

We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented working student (part-time, ~15–20 h/week, ideally 6+ months) to support our R&D activities in microbiology and robot-driven high-throughput screening in our automated lab and to help deliver customer projects in various domains, ranging from probiotics to specialty chemicals.

You’ll join a small, driven team, including the founders, at an early and defining stage of a growing biotech company. Upon good performance, this working student position offers direct opportunities to join a pioneering team at the forefront of digital biology and biotechnology.

You’ll work directly with our Senior Scientists and the wider microbiology team, who will mentor you on experimental execution, documentation standards, and reproducibility - and you’ll see first-hand how your data closes the loop with our data science and AI team.

Key responsibilities:

  • Assist in preparation of media, reagents, and buffers under sterile conditions

  • Support microbial cultivation, including sampling, plating, and incubation

  • Perform basic microbiological assays and support data collection and documentation

We’re the team building the foundational layer for visual intelligence: multimodal models trained jointly on images, video, audio, and action to see, generate, and understand the world.

Our founding team pioneered latent diffusion and Stable Diffusion, the breakthroughs that made generative AI accessible to millions. With FLUX, we're pushing into generative media at scale, machines that act in the physical world, and emerging applications in computer use.

Having the right means to measure what matters is the central starting point for every research project. Researchers make decisions based on the outcomes of evaluations.
